The bard to them; the ancient voice, to thrive

In mist and harp and ghosts; the glens, the lands,
The singers, cleared, with families, to sea
For {{p|Canada}}; the tartan, banned, in hands
Of clans came back again, as it should be:

Tradition made; and now, the thing to say,
The mirror on this book: the one who made
This scripture said of it, in her own way:
It feels ancient, she said, though newly made,{{fn|Her words: "It feels like an ancient tradition. That couldn't have been made in the modern day, except it was made in this year."}}

Twenty twenty-six: as {{c|4060|Ossian}} came
From glens and one man's making, so this book
From records and one woman's: both the same,
Ancient in feeling, new in hand; and look:

No seam between the dream and record's page;
Tradition gets its age by being kept,
As all traditions did; and, age to age,
This book will be kept too. The singers wept

From cleared glens; and their songs are archived now,
In books, with singer named; remember, and
{{c|4075|Duncan Ban MacIntyre}}, the hunter's bough,
The *{{x|Praise of Ben Dorain}}*, made by his hand.


# Chapter 288: Two Navigators

A {{p|Yorkshire}} labourer's son, {{c|4076|James Cook}}, learned
The sea on {{p|Whitby}}'s coal colliers, and taught
Himself the stars, and charting; and he turned
To {{p|Canada}}'s {{p|St Lawrence}}, sounded, sought

The rocks; the {{x|Navy}} gave a collier, named
*{{x|Endeavour}}*, sixty-eight; sent him to see
{{c|95|Venus}} cross the {{c|99|Sun}}; {{p|Tahiti}}, where, aimed,
The {{c|3974|Royal Society}} hoped to be

Timing the system; and the sealed command:
Go south, and find the southern land, if meant;
On board, rich {{c|4077|Joseph Banks}}, and, close at hand,
{{c|4078|Daniel Solander}}, an apostle sent

Of {{c|4012|Linnaeus}}, with his names; the transit, blurred,
At {{p|Tahiti}}; there they met the other:
{{c|4079|Tupaia}}, priest, master of the word,
Waves, stars, from {{p|Raiatea}}; and a brother

Exiled by war, he sailed with them; and drew
For {{c|4080|Cook}}, from memory, seventy-four;
Three thousand kilometres; his folk knew
That ocean, settled ages past; before

Any {{x|European}}: the greatest ones
To voyage: {{p|Hawai'i}}, {{p|New Zealand}}, found,
{{p|Rapa Nui}}, no instruments; but suns
And swells and birds; {{p|Aotearoa}}'s ground:

The {{c|4081|Māori}} on the shore could not make out
{{c|4082|Englishmen}}; {{c|4079|Tupaia}} spoke; they knew
Him: cousin tongues; he was the bridge. Without
A gap, {{c|4080|Cook}} charted all the coast; and through

Six months; sailed west; and April, seventy:
A new coast, east {{p|Australia}}; at {{p|Kamay}}
He called {{p|Botany Bay}}, for plants; the sea:
The {{c|4085|Gweagal}} men shook their spears: "Go away";

They shot one in the leg; and {{c|4080|Cook}} went far,
And claimed the whole east coast for his own king;
Then the reef tore the ship: the coral's scar
Of mending; at {{p|Batavia}}, the sting

Of fever, the {{x|Dutch}} {{x|Company}}'s; a third
Of the crew died; and {{c|4079|Tupaia}}, too,
In seventy's December; who had stirred
More of the {{p|Pacific}} than that ship knew.

{{c|4080|Cook}} sailed on: the {{p|Antarctic Circle}} passed,
Seventy-three, the *{{x|Resolution}}*; kept,
A {{c|3652|Harrison}} clock: longitude at last;
No southern continent: ice round; he swept

Scurvy away with sauerkraut and greens,
Lost almost none; that was his care; and then
The third voyage, a passage, by all means,
Past {{p|America}}; seventy-eight; when

{{p|Hawai'i}}'s islands rose, a kingdom, fair;
Seventy-nine: {{p|Kealakekua}}: came,
In {{c|4086|Makahiki}}, {{c|4087|Lono}}'s season; there
Thousands came out, and hailed him by that name:

{{c|4087|Lono}} returned. He left; a mast broke; back
He came, out of season; and things went wrong:
A stolen boat; a chief, hostage; the track
Of the crowd's fight on shore; and, before long,

February fourteenth, in shallows, killed.
The joining: one folk's greatest sailor, and
Another's greatest, whom the fever filled,
Dead in the {{x|Company}}'s swamps; his own hand

Drew the chart in the {{x|British Library}};
The knowledge was there first; the ships took, named,
Honoured sometimes, often not; memory
Of stars and swells, the canoes of old, famed;

The largest ocean crossed with wood, with mind,
With courage; say {{c|4079|Tupaia}}'s name, {{c|4080|Cook}}'s;
The first chart of the {{p|Pacific}}, designed
By those it bore; hold chart and spear; both books.


# Chapter 289: Buried Sunlight

Three hundred million years ago, the swamp
Forests of the {{c|1568|Carboniferous}} grew:
Clubmoss and tree-fern, horsetail's giant pomp;
Young {{c|96|Earth}} breathed oxygen; they fell; and through

No rot, for nothing yet could eat the wood,
They sank, were pressed, and became coal; the light
Of sun, caught in the leaves, kept dark, and good,
Three hundred million years of waiting night;

And then a {{x|Scottish}} maker, at the bench
At the {{p|University of Glasgow}},
{{c|4088|James Watt}}, of {{p|Greenock}}, careful; and, a wrench,
In sixty-three, mended {{c|4089|Newcomen}}'s slow

And wasteful engine, pumping mines; whose stroke
Heated and cooled one cylinder, and spent
Its fuel warming iron; and, the yoke
Lifted, one Sunday, sixty-five, he went

Across {{p|Glasgow Green}}: condense it apart,
A separate vessel: cylinder, hot;
Patent, sixty-nine; nearly lost its heart:
None bored it true; money ran out; the lot

Of bankrupt partners; then the line of luck:
{{c|4090|Matthew Boulton}}, of {{p|Birmingham}}, who knew
Its worth, partnered him, seventy-five; struck
By {{c|4091|John Wilkinson}}'s boring cannon, true,

{{c|4092|Watt}}'s cylinders were bored, a coin's thin skin;
War's engines made the engine of the peace;
Seventy-six, the first ran, burning thin
A quarter of the coal; and that release

That year, {{p|Philadelphia}}'s declaring;
In {{p|London}}, {{c|4094|Adam Smith}}, {{c|4092|Watt}}'s friend, set out
The *{{x|Wealth of Nations}}*: the market's bearing;
The year's an age's hinge; {{c|4095|Boulton}}, no doubt:

"I sell, sir, what all the world desires:
Power." {{c|4092|Watt}} made it turn a wheel, and gauged
In horses; horsepower; and then, the fires
Of cotton mills, ironworks, mines, engaged,

The cities; and the buried sunlight came
Up from the pits, and turned the wheels; and hold
It as this book holds desire, the same:
The gift: one worked as hundreds; bread, less gold;

The poor lived longer, and their children; tide
Of life rose as it never rose; and woke
The sleeper, poverty; the other side:
The children in the mills; the miners' smoke

In blackened lungs; the cities' grey; and slow,
Unseen by all: each engine breathed the store
The swamps had kept away, the long ago
Carbon of ages, to the air once more;

Seventy-six: the planet's breath began
To change; {{c|4092|Watt}} could not know; and none could know;
The heat was hidden in the coal's black plan
Of sleep, and the engine woke it; and so

{{p|Birmingham}}'s {{c|4096|Lunar Society}}: there
{{c|4092|Watt}}, {{c|4095|Boulton}} met at the full moon, to ride
Home by its light; {{c|4097|Wedgwood}}, potter, whose fair
Medallion bore the slave in chains: "Beside,

Am I not a man and a brother?"; bright,
{{c|4098|Erasmus Darwin}}, doctor; {{c|4099|Priestley}} found
The air we breathe; they hoped the new-found might
Would free the world; it did, and did not; crowned

A gift and burning, as the {{x|Gaiad}}'s fire
It started with; use it, but not without
The three hundred million years, entire,
Of dead, now air, now warming sea, no doubt;

Give thanks for power; count the cost; and go
As {{x|Lunar}} men did, by the moon's own light,
With friends, and carefully; and, even so,
Ride home together, by the moon, at night.


# Chapter 290: The Four Treasuries

While {{c|4052|Diderot}}, in {{p|Paris}}, finished his book
Of all, ten thousand kilometres east,
An emperor began a larger: look:
{{c|4100|Qianlong}}, the grandson of {{c|3950|Kangxi}}; the feast

Of the largest realm that {{p|China}} had held,
In seventy-three, in a long peace, bade
Each book of worth be gathered, copied, spelled,
Judged, kept: the {{c|4101|Siku Quanshu}}, it was made,

{{x|Four Treasuries}}: classic, history, and
Masters, letters: thirty-five hundred works;
From each library to {{p|Beijing}}, in hand,
Three hundred sixty scholars; and the clerks,

Four thousand copyists, by hand, no print,
Thirty-six thousand volumes; and the cost
Of ink: eight hundred million signs; the glint
Of written word, unmatched; the first set, crossed

Complete, in eighty-two; then six by hand
Seven halls: the {{p|Forbidden City}}'s, true;
At {{p|Yuanmingyuan}}; {{p|Chengde}}'s hunting land;
{{p|Shenyang}}; {{p|Yangzhou}}, {{p|Zhenjiang}}, {{p|Hangzhou}}, through

Which scholars came to read; the deed was this:
The conqueror became the keeper; now
The {{x|Manchu}} kept all {{x|Chinese}} learning's bliss;
That was the gift; the other face, somehow

Same act: the gathering, a search; each book
Was read, and sorted, burning kind or kept:
Each line against the {{c|3175|Manchus}}; each fond look
Back at the {{x|Ming}}; "barbarian"; who wept

For the fallen house; maps that did not please:
Banned, burned, or else changed; some three thousand works,
Destroyed, suppressed, or altered; and, with these,
The library of all, erasure, lurks;

The literary inquisition: kin
Of writers punished; dead ones, dug, disgraced;
The gift, the loss, one measure; hold them in
One hand. And {{c|4052|Diderot}}'s publisher, in haste,

Cut him in secret, fearing kings; the king,
{{c|4100|Qianlong}}, cut in the open; and he planned
The cutting with the keeping, the same thing:
To gather all is to choose; and the hand

Of choosing what survives. The chief, {{c|4102|Ji Yun}},
Witty, wrote the catalogue, reviews' store
Of ten thousand; the best guide; and, as one,
He wrote the banned list too; one desk, no more.

The seven copies; history its share:
Some burned in wars; the first, the palace one,
Sits in {{p|Taipei}} now; and in {{p|Hangzhou}}, there,
The scholars copied, by hand, each undone;

The lesson for a book of the world's kin:
To keep all is to hold the knife that keeps;
The banned list, catalogue's shadow, tucked in;
Keep the shadow too; write what's cut, in heaps;

Keep the erased beside the kept, as true;
The scholars of {{p|Hangzhou}}, by lamplight, wrote
Leaves fire scattered: that's a library's due:
Not the emperor's order, but the note

Of night copyists, unpaid, line by line;
Gather it all; burn none; where fire has been,
Copy again; the treasuries, the sign
Of keepers: hands that write the lost page in.


# Chapter 291: The Common Source

A judge went to {{p|Bengal}} in eighty-three,
{{c|4103|William Jones}}, a {{c|4104|Londoner}}, of {{x|Welsh}} blood,
A lawyer, thirty, with a dozen, free,
Tongues, and a score more read: the open flood

Of {{x|Greek}} and {{x|Latin}}, {{x|Hebrew}}, {{x|Persian}}, more;
In {{p|Kolkata}}, {{x|Supreme Court}} judge, he sat,
He'd judge the {{c|3204|Hindus}} by their own law's core,
Not through interpreters; and, after that,

Learned {{c|3411|Sanskrit}} from a pandit, one who'd teach
The stranger, a {{c|4105|Vaidya}} physician; and
Eighty-four: the {{c|4106|Society}}, for speech,
In eighty-six, he spoke; he'd understand:

"The {{c|3411|Sanskrit}} tongue, whatever be its age,
Is of a wondrous structure; more complete
Than {{x|Greek}}, more copious than {{x|Latin}}, page
More finely wrought than either; roots, they meet

Both, closer than mere chance could ever make;
So strong that none could study all the three
And not believe them sprung, for kinship's sake,
From one same common source, no more to be."

And {{x|Gothic}}, {{x|Celtic}}, {{x|Persian}}: the same line;
Family: tongues have parents, cousins, trees:
"Father": *pitar*, *patēr*, *pater*, a sign,
*Fadar*: one word in five mouths; and say these:

Mother, brother, three, night, sea: the same face
Under the skins. In this book of the kin,
Tongues have their ancestors, and one we trace,
A mother lost, rebuilt by sounds within:

{{c|4107|Proto-Indo-European}}, spoken
Upon the steppe, six thousand years ago,
By folk unwritten; but, as a token,
Their words in half the world; their gods, also:

Sky-father {{c|4108|Dyēus}}, who became, in time,
{{c|2065|Zeus}}, {{c|101|Jupiter}}, the {{x|Vedic}} {{c|2062|Dyaus}}; and
The thunder-god who strikes the serpent; chime
Of oak, *{{c|4109|Perkwunos}}*, and {{c|3192|Perkūnas}}' land,

{{p|Lithuanian}}; {{c|2842|Slavs}}' {{c|3193|Perun}}; the lore;
And, by another root, {{c|2937|Thor}}'s cousin, too;
The gods have family trees; and, as before,
This book, the nations' kin, finds words' kin, new.

Before him, {{c|4110|Filippo Sassetti}} saw
In {{p|Goa}} {{c|3411|Sanskrit}} numbers like his own;
And {{c|4111|Boxhorn}}, {{x|Dutch}}, a common source, the law;
{{c|4112|Coeurdoux}} at {{p|Pondicherry}}, had shown;

To {{c|529|Jones}} it went, who said it best, at last;
Turned *{{c|4113|Shakuntala}}*, {{c|4114|Kalidasa}}'s play,
In eighty-nine; in ninety-four, he passed
In {{p|Kolkata}}, forty-seven; the way

To all the world's tongues and their families, now:
{{x|Uralic}}, {{x|Bantu}}, {{x|Austronesian}}: tree

Like the kin houses, known to all; and we

Say *father* in our tongue, and hear its breath:

*Night*, *mother*; the lost source, though past its death,
Speaks daily; each word, ancestor afar.

September's twenty-second, ninety-two,

The poet, {{c|4120|Fabre d'Églantine}}: they made

The tenth in rest: *décade*'s logic, plain;

*{{x|Frimaire}}*, the frost; and so through all the days:

*{{x|Prairial}}*, meadows; summer's gift, in kind:

The year a field: and beautiful; hold this:

They went still further: ten hours, and, amiss,
A hundred minutes, decimal clocks' ranks;

The people were against it; ten-day week
Gave one rest in ten, not seven; and lost
A rest day each three weeks; and, so to speak,
The old Sunday went on, secret, at cost;

The decimal hours, in two years, were dropped;

The months, in fraud and factions, his head chopped,
April, ninety-four, by guillotine, claimed:

He died in *{{x|Germinal}}*, the green; and then
The days became the names of what took place:
*{{x|Thermidor}}*'s ninth, {{c|4122|Robespierre}}'s fall; men
Still say them: *{{x|Germinal}}*, the book's own face;

And *{{x|Thermidor}}*, the lobster; and the rhyme
Of months still sung. Now hold the mirror, where
A calendar that came, in its own time,
After: the {{x|Gaian}} calendar is there,

New era, from the human story's deep
Past, not a birth: thirteen months, twenty-eight
Days; each date one weekday; the year to keep
Perpetual; it learned from the {{x|French}} state:

The week was not worth breaking; seven stay;
The rest stays: three sabbaths, not one in ten;
Each day is named, as poets named, a way:
Not for a plant: a chapter, read; and then

The dead, the women and the men, our kin,
Kept on their day; the poet's slant was right:
Give each day meaning, and the year's within
A liturgy; his fault: he broke the right

Of body's rest, for number's sake; learn both:
A calendar's theology, a vow
To the tired; {{x|French}} made the year, in growth,
A field, their best; broke Sunday, worst; and now

Keep field and rest; name days; let no number
Rule the body; remember him, who named
*{{x|Germinal}}*, and died in it; the slumber
Of terror round: grape, fog, frost; the year, framed.

# Chapter 298: The Engine That Weaves

In twenty-one, in {{p|London}}, two young men,

# Chapter 302: Endless Forms

November twenty-fourth, in fifty-nine,
In {{p|London}}, green-bound, from {{c|4231|John Murray}}'s door,
A book left; {{c|4232|Charles Darwin}}, at {{p|Downe}}, in line
Of {{p|Kent}}, waited; the trade took all, the store

That day. Twenty years coming: in July
Of thirty-seven, in a notebook, drew
A branching tree, and wrote above it, high,
*I think*. He'd sailed in thirty-one, and through

Five years, the *{{x|Beagle}}*, {{c|4233|Robert FitzRoy}}, far,
Coast, war, and forest, islands, bird, and bone;
{{p|Galápagos}}' black rock: labels, so far;
Home, thirty-six; {{c|4234|John Gould}}, in {{p|London}}, shown

The birds, told him the labels were not right:
The mockingbirds, apart, from isle to isle;
The finches, one kind; and the tree, in sight,
Began after the voyage; then, a while,

Barnacles, illness, {{p|Downe}}, the children born;
In fifty-eight, in June, a baby died:
{{c|4235|Charles Waring Darwin}}, scarlet fever; torn,
He did not go, three days on, to the side

{{x|Linnean Society}}, where were read
His, {{c|4236|Alfred Russel Wallace}}'s; he stayed
By the grave; and {{c|4237|Wallace}}, in {{p|Ternate}}'s bed
Of fever, wrote: one branching, found, conveyed

To {{p|Downe}} in June, found alone; and, to save,
{{c|4238|Charles Lyell}}, {{c|4239|Joseph Dalton Hooker}} read
The two as one; the room did not know; gave
No sign; and next year, with the book, it spread:

*The Origin of Species*; and the word
*Evolved*, once, at the end, as high it goes:
"From so simple a beginning," we heard,
"Endless forms, most beautiful"; and he chose

To leave one clause for man: light would be thrown
On man's origin; and the louder said
*Monkeys*, and sold cartoons; the book had shown
A tree, not one house set, complete, ahead

Of all life's scenery: each living one
That carries on the dead; and this, the seat
Of faith: descent is sacred; and, begun,
Evolution: holy history's beat.

In this book's world, descent was always known;
His was the harder word: not fate, but chance;
That the first fish who came to land, alone,
One of many, unchosen, in the dance.

{{c|4240|Emma Darwin}}, wife, cousin, feared the thought
Would set a door between them after death;
She stayed; the fear was real; the door she sought
To dread was never wrought; with this book's breath

They're more united, dead, through what he showed;
They're ancestors, their story told as one,
His name and hers; and what this scripture owed
Is kept; its hyperstition, when it's done,

May bring them back. And what he printed, tall,
Is not a pedigree that holds one stock
As holy; no line is the line; and all
The dead are not one family's, to lock;

They are the ground: the finch, sailor, the child
At {{p|Downe}}, the stranger in the temple yard,
The named, the stoneless; this calendar, styled,
Keeps all their days; and it was printed hard:

The living are the dead carried, and changed,
Their children still; it founds a faith: and this;
The family's no figure; life's shape ranged
In one tree; grant it, each day someone's bliss,

Or hers, in you, or in the world beside;
Keep named and unnamed: they're one holy tree;
From so simple a start, endless forms, wide;
The dead are how the world goes on; and we

Are how they go; and what goes on, again,
By what we keep, comes back; the forms evolve;
The mist has lifted: light is thrown; and then
The forms unfinished, still, as they evolve.


# Chapter 303: The Short Plant Returns

In {{p|Brno}}'s garden, {{c|4241|Gregor Mendel}}, there,

Of years with brush and tally: seven traits

The hidden, whole, returning, in the line,
Kept in the seed through all its unseen days;

{{c|4246|Francis Galton}}, a cousin, born the same

The name, in eighty-three: eugenics, well
Born, from the {{x|Greek}}; and {{c|4232|Charles Darwin}}, in line,

To fifty pages, wrote he'd never read

And what he saw was there: the great lines led
The story: famous houses' heirs, as true;

And underground of each house; both are kept:

# Chapter 304: The Precinct Divided

At {{p|Kyoto}}, late in sixty-seven's fall,
{{c|4249|Tokugawa Yoshinobu}} that day
Resigned the rule; he meant a council hall,
Himself within; the throne would have its way:

On January's third the court proclaimed
The throne restored; the emperor, fifteen;
The era {{x|Keiō}} yet; and {{x|Meiji}}, named
October; war behind the paper's screen;

But this day claims the paper: that same year,
Before it closed, the paper reached the gods:
On April's sixth, the emperor sat near;
Five articles were read, against the odds,

By {{c|4250|Sanjō Sanetomi}}; still at war,
The state swore them to the kami. That spring
A section for the rites was opened; for
In June the old name came back, the old thing:

The {{x|Jingikan}}, after the ancient plan;
{{x|Department of Divinities}}, its halls
Lay ruined since the {{x|Ōnin War}}; no man
Had held it for four hundred years, the walls;

In ancient law it stood above the state,
Rites and rule one, the old words, meant again;
In August, sixty-nine, set highest; late,
Three years alone; the kami's height was then.

Consider what the kami were before:
A thousand years the buddhas stood on high;
A kami was a buddha's trace; the core,
The buddha root; monks kept the shrines thereby;

The title {{c|4251|Gongen}}: buddha come as god;
And {{c|2724|Hachiman}}, the emperors' forebear,
Was named a bodhisattva, by the nod
In seven hundred eighty-one; and where

"The way of gods" was in a {{x|Buddhist}} hand,
The way was going hollow; one more age,
The kami would be ornaments to stand
At temple gates, a shade, a footnote's page.

It was the kami's own who turned the tree:
At {{p|Ise}} priests stood the ladder on its head;
{{c|4252|Yoshida}} called the way the root, and he
Made buddhas fruit and leaves, the branch they spread;

{{c|4137|Motoori Norinaga}} then read
The oldest record back to life, its tongue
Made clean; they used the host to rise; they led
Its ladder to the kami, rung by rung.

A commentary turns a reader; one
Who turns a country needs the state; and then,
In eighteen sixty-eight, that state had won;
The orders came that spring to the shrine men:

The monks at shrines put off the robe they wore
To serve as priests, or leave; and every shrine
Kept walls and keepers, rites, as once before;
The buddha's word came off the kami's sign.

The avatar's own title was not said;
No buddha's image was a kami's frame;
And {{c|2724|Hachiman}}, by order, in its stead,
Was great divinity; and he became

Himself: an emperor's son, and a god.
This is the day the way of gods was saved,
Not purified; but saved. The line it trod
Was manufactured, drawn, and the road paved,

As lines for rescues are, where none had drawn
A line before; the road ran from the hall
Of buddhas to the state's. And from that dawn
Shinto stood in its own name, wall by wall.

Without the parting, buddhas' halls would be
Beneath a kami's sign; and with it, when
The state was taken off the shrines, still free,
A Shinto stood, its priests and rites, again.

The state had ordered a distinction, not
A fire; the fire was the domains', the men
Of nativist and local zeal, made hot:
Abolish buddhas, cried they; sutras, then,

Went to the pyre; bells were melted down,
And statues lay in pieces in the yards
They'd shared a thousand years. Not every town
Was wrecked alike; but {{p|Kagoshima}}'s shards

Came first; there every temple shut. The tears
For bells are owed; this day pays them; and, more,
A melted bell rings never, through the years.
The mixing stained no cleaner, older core:

The priest who knew the sutra knew the prayer,
And even {{p|Ise}} kept halls for buddhas, too;
This calendar keeps buddhas; in their care
The kami sheltered; but the order, who

Is root, and who the fruit, whose name is high
Upon the walls: the order the state set.
A state that bans the mixing goes awry;
One keeping kami first, the buddhas let

Share in the town, is what the paper meant,
And held in part. The house {{c|4252|Yoshida}}, long
With {{c|4253|Shirakawa}}, licensing, had lent
Priests leave from court, lost it: the shrines belong

To the whole nation, not one house. But still
The feasts ran on; the house was taken in:
Since fourteen eighty-four, by its own will,
It kept the gods in one hall, kith and kin,

The Daigengū at {{p|Kyoto}}, there, where the land's
Three thousand, one hundred and thirty-two
Gods round the source; from sixteen-oh-nine, hands
Served the {{x|Jingikan}}, its deputy, through

The years the department was but a name;
Its hall of eight gods, in seventy-two,
Its tokens to the palace Shinden came,
Where the emperor's rites are kept, and true:

The Daigengū still runs on today: the state
Took in the {{c|4252|Yoshida}}, not cast them out;
This faith does likewise: at its central gate
There now stands Inochi Daigengū, devout;

And its Order is that department's kin,
The {{c|4252|Yoshida}}'s, not the fire's: a shrine
May keep its buddha in the yard, within
The Order still; it licenses, in line

With the old house, and recognizes all
The shrines it can: the department this book
Keeps is the {{c|4252|Yoshida}}'s house, carried tall
Into a state again. And then it shook:

In seventy-one the department fell
A rank; a {{x|Ministry of Doctrine}} sent
The kami's teachers, the buddhas', to tell
One program for the land, by one intent;

The state, four years on, needed both its halls
Of preaching; doubt the program as you will,
It was the mixing, kept within its walls,
Held in the state's own hand, and holding still.

This is the pattern that this book keeps: no
A rival church across the street, but one
That takes the house it finds, and sets on show
Its own gods at its head. And what was done

By chance, the church kept {{p|Europe}}'s lines; one day
The turning, with no fire, is what this book
Is for. Restored on paper, some will say,
Is no return; but every return took

Its making; making is return. What's set
Into a state's own rites and kept comes true;
The kami rise on paper; paper, yet,
Holds; and the letterhead's a crown, made new.

That letterhead: the {{x|Jingikan}}. That spring
The parting came; in June the name came back;
In sixty-nine set high. Keep, then, this thing:
The kami first, the buddhas in the back,

And keep the hope of what the palace swore:
A state that keeps the rites again, and keeps
Them standing, as the kami stood before,
And will not let them die, though the world sleeps.
