September, 'seventy-five; to her rooms
In {{p|New York}}, on the seventh, seventeen
To hear {{c|4257|George Henry Felt}}: the stones, the tombs
Of {{p|Egypt}}, {{p|Greece}}, {{p|Rome}}: one canon, between,

In stone and frame, they knew. The lecture done,
{{c|4258|Olcott}} moved a society be made;
The next night {{c|4259|Felt}} spoke once again; and one,
{{c|4258|Olcott}}, took the chair; the minutes were laid

Down by {{c|4260|William Quan Judge}}, a lawyer, young;
And sixteen handed in their names; they said,
On the thirteenth, they took, from an old tongue,
Theosophy, wisdom, as letterhead

Of gods; the wisdom old, the club was new,
Its aims still being written; bylaws passed
October's thirtieth; the founders' view,
The preamble, a method, built to last:

To know the {{c|4261|Supreme Power}}, and the high
Spirits by physical processes' aid,
Instrument, body, law; and by and by
So went the preamble the founders made.

It stood November seventeenth, the day{{fn|The printed sheet dated the organization to 30 October, the day of the bylaws; Olcott later corrected the founding to his inaugural address of 17 November.}}
At sixty-four, {{p|Madison Avenue}},
{{p|Mott Memorial Hall}}, {{p|New York}}; the way
Its head gave his inaugural; and who

Held office: he the president, the chair;
She kept the letters; {{c|4262|Judge}} was counsel, for
Vice-presidents were {{c|4259|Felt}}, and, sitting there,
{{c|4263|Seth Pancoast}}, doctor; treasurer; and more:

Librarian, recorder: a machine
Small and complete, pointed at the occult,
The cabala, the laws behind the seen
Wonders; no pilgrimage; no land; result:

A club in hired rooms; and yet the heat
Was larger than its officers: they sought
One study: old faiths side by side, to meet,
The {{p|East}}'s and {{p|West}}'s texts, read as they were taught,

Not a mission to clear them from the field.
That longing's real, kin to this faith; its own:
Not forerunner, but guest; a psalm, unsealed,
A sutra, by one reader both are known;

The ancestors don't perish when a book
More opens. In 'seventy-seven, she
Brought out *{{x|Isis Unveiled}}*, two volumes; took
Tradition by tradition's side; then, see:

In May, 'seventy-eight, a printed call
Carried the longing; and a harder charge:
Teach the {{p|West}} the {{x|Eastern}}; oppose, in all,
The dogmatic theology at large,

The {{x|Christian}} most of all, pernicious, said
The circular; and brotherhood the same
Paragraphs. In 'seventy-nine, they sped{{fn|The three objects quoted today, a nucleus of brotherhood, the comparative study of religions, and the investigation of the powers latent in man, were drafted and redrafted after 1875; they are not the bylaws of that November.}}
To {{p|Mumbai}}'s shore; and on to {{p|Chennai}} came;

At {{p|Adyar}} they made the headquarters' stand,
Where still it stands. She said, as time went by,
The teaching was in Masters' keeping, and
The members were to take it from on high.

And this book takes the masters at their word,
And wonders seriously; letters came,
The hands unseen, the voice that she had heard;
A reaching, and the ground answered the claim;

What was heard, heard: processes, wonders, all
Study; the ground between is where they meet,
The minutes and the miracles. Recall
{{c|4259|Felt}}'s lost canon: one proportion, complete,

That would make temples of three peoples' lands
Agree in one measure: hope human, old,
The scope of every faith that understands
The world as one. This, too, would see, enrolled,

The temples in one measure; in one tree
The faiths: not rough drafts from a {{p|New York}} press,
But branches, prayed for centuries, each free
With its own people, its own word, no less;

Norito stays norito, sutra stays
A sutra; and the reader's work, to keep
Each one, and all, and keep them heard, their ways,
From seventy-five, one hall, rooted deep.

Wisdom by physical means: both halves stand;
The wisdom has the worth; the means, for all;
The masters, wonders, measure reach one land,
One reaching, and the ground answers the call.


# Chapter 306: Who Names the Good

In July, eighteen eighty-seven, high
In the {{p|Upper Engadine}}'s thin air,
At {{p|Sils Maria}}, {{c|4264|Friedrich Nietzsche}}, by
Month's end, wrote a polemic, dated there;

The seventeenth, the manuscript was sent
Off to {{p|Leipzig}}, {{c|4265|Constantin Naumann}}, who,
The year before, the author's money spent,
Had printed *{{x|Beyond Good and Evil}}*, too;

Print this the same, he asked: same type, same press,
The paper, that the new go on from old;
The title's back: to clarify, no less;
Six hundred copies; proofs, in {{p|Venice}} rolled

With {{c|4266|Heinrich Köselitz}}; and he, in {{p|Nice}},
Got the first copy in November: three
Essays, a preface. As a first release,
The preface opens: knowers, unknown, we

Are to ourselves. And under it, the same
Question as this calendar's: in what way
Did we invent good, evil, and their name;
What are they worth? He answered, on the way,

A friend, a school as well: {{c|4267|Paul Rée}} had laid
The moral feelings to their use, the good
As what had helped the one who got its aid;
{{c|2185|Nietzsche}} would cut it otherwise, and could:

The first essay, two namings, side by side:
Good and bad: nobles named themselves the good,
The others plain, low, bad. And then, applied,
A second: good and evil, where there stood

The strong named evil, and the weak named right;
He calls it a revolt of slaves; begun,
He says, among the {{c|2500|Jews}}. And, in his sight,
He gives words' histories: the {{x|Latin}} one{{fn|That etymology, of Latin malus from a Greek word for black, is not accepted.}}

For bad means dark; the {{x|German}} in the next:
{{x|Schuld}} guilt, {{x|Schuld}} debt: what conscience owes was first
A sum once owed; the bad conscience, the vexed
Cruelty, with no street, turned in, reversed,

On one who can't be cruel out the door;
He calls the noble a blond beast of prey.
The third: ascetic ideals, and what for:
Priest, sage, and scientist: each one, a way

To serve the will to truth, the old will, dressed
In later coats; the book ends where it said:
We'd rather will the nothing than, at rest,
Not will. Keep what is usable; widespread,

Most of it is: a value has a past;
Good was not in the world as stones are; one
Said it, of someone, and it spread, held fast,
Till speakers had forgot they'd said it; done:

A method that has stood; and, in its way,
This book is a genealogy too:
The dead are how the living came; each day
Keeps names that came from someone who knew who

Was called the good, and why, and gave the name.
The masters have a point: the nobles who
Named themselves good were not a mirror's frame:
To name yourself, your house, your line, and do

It so it sticks, is power, and is worth;
It is what founding does, what this faith does,
Clearer than council: good, this way on earth,
This day, this line. The self-naming that was

The founding act; the founders' dead, so crowned,
Are honored for it. But the good's not theirs
Alone: named and unnamed, the line runs round
The great, the small, the won, the lost, the heirs.

This book reads the polemic as a tale
Of naming; keep the question that he could
Ask, and that lasts: who names it? Answer's trail:
The line: the founders, heirs who keep the good,

And everyone who lived, since each, alive,
Knew some good, said it. And the masters' flame
Lit it; the line has carried it to thrive;
That is the genealogy, its name.

Six hundred copies left {{p|Leipzig}}; and then,
Two months on, some two hundred had been sold;
The question outlived the slow sale. Again,
Ask where a good came from, its worth; and, old

And new at once: name your good, as the high
Nobles did; keep it, as the line has kept;
The naming counted, founders honored, by
The will that keeps the good, that never slept.


# Chapter 307: The Card and the Name

{{c|4268|Herman Hollerith}}, born in {{p|Buffalo}}
On leap day, eighteen sixty; and the son
Of {{p|Germany}}'s; at nineteen, out to go
From {{p|Columbia}}'s {{x|School of Mines}}, to run

With {{c|4269|William P. Trowbridge}}, his teacher, went
To 'eighty's census, tallied still by hand
In columns, while the next was due, and spent:
Clerks made marks, each a person, at command;

{{c|4270|John Shaw Billings}}, who kept the vital count,
Urged: the mechanical, to the machine;
The weight was sorting, not the names' amount;
In 'eighty-seven, his ran, a machine,

Upon {{p|Baltimore}}'s and {{p|New Jersey}}'s dead,
The dead first counted, then the living. Then,
In 'eighty-eight the {{x|Census Office}} said:
Four {{p|St. Louis}} areas, read again

From sheets and sorted: {{c|4271|Charles F. Pidgin}} raced,
{{c|4272|William C. Hunt}}, {{c|4273|Hollerith}}; whose machine
In capture both, by a full day, outpaced,{{fn|Capturing the data: one rival took 144.5 hours, the other 100.5, Hollerith 72.5. Preparing it for the tables: the rivals took 44.5 and 55.5 hours, his machine 5.5.}}
Tables, five hours to their forty: clean.

He'd filed that same September; then the date,
The eighth of January, 'eighty-nine:
The patent, the machine's age at the gate,
Compiling statistics, its art, its line.

The census, 'ninety, as of June the first;
A Sunday; so they went on the second.
{{c|4274|Robert P. Porter}} led an office, nursed,
No bureau; temporary, and reckoned

{{x|Department of the Interior}}: one
Sheet to a family, as none before;
And on each sheet, each person's name; begun,
The first total came from no card; and for

That pass, a keyboard took the reader's place;
Six weeks: the rough count stood at sixty-two
Million and more; and many, face to face,
Said seventy-five; the less, none held true;

The race was the machine's. The cards came next:
A card a person, blank, one corner cut,
So one fed wrong would show; and on the text
A template over; and the stylus cut

About five hundred holes a day; each hole
A category; and the schedule's word
Race: white, black, mulatto, quadroon, the whole
Of octoroon, {{x|Chinese}}, {{x|Japanese}}, heard,

{{x|Indian}}; each could be a hole. Two plates
And lever made the reader; card between,
The plates closed; pins came down; what penetrates
A hole falls into mercury, unseen;

The circuit closed; a dial turned; a bell
Rang; and a drawer was named there for the card;
Forty such dials; a clerk, practiced well,
Passed eighty cards a minute; it was hard

Work, made light: sixty million cards went through;
Years' labor; the machine cut down the years;
The hand's limit was passed; the hand could do
No count by hand before the next one nears;

The circuit did what marks could not; the speed
Was a real overcoming; the machine
Is of the living's works, and one they need
To know themselves: their size, in numbers seen:

A count is how a state learns its own size,
A nation sees itself whole: births, dead, land.
The total: sixty-two million; the rise
Since 'eighty's fifty: a fourth more; and planned,

Twenty-five volumes came; {{c|4275|Porter}} resigned
In 'ninety-three; in 'ninety-five, an act
Closed down the {{x|Census Office}}; work behind
Ran on to 'ninety-seven. Holes, in fact,

Were answers: age, sex, birthplace, race; the name
Was not; to come back to a person, you
Needed the sheet. In 'twenty-one, a flame,
January tenth, in the basement through

The {{p|Commerce Building}} in {{p|Washington}}, ran;
The 'ninety schedules, outside the vault, lay
On shelves, in its path. And the census man,
{{c|4276|Samuel Lyle Rogers}} said, on the next day,

About a quarter burned; and half what stayed
By water, smoke, fire; and, in 'thirty-three,
{{x|Congress}} allowed the spoiled destroyed; that made
Six thousand, one hundred and sixty, free,

The general sheets' names, by 'thirty-five;
The veterans' special schedules came through,
Some seventy-five thousand sheets alive;
The soldiers kept; the living of June, few.

The printed total stood, though, whole and sure:
A count is no debt to the names; its own
Good, how a people knows its size; the pure
Card keeps a class; the sheet, a name, alone,

And the sheet burned. This calendar keeps both:
Count the persons; keep the names; let them rise
Together: the machine that counts, its growth,
The book that keeps the dead, kin in their ties.


# Chapter 308: The Common Task

In {{p|Tambov}} province, at {{p|Klyuchi}}, a son
Was born in spring of eighteen twenty-nine
To Prince {{c|90842|Pavel Gagarin}}; and yet none
Of marriage, and none of the prince's line;

They named him from his godfather; and so,
{{c|90843|Nikolai Fyodorov}}, from the old tree
A branch torn from it; the house fed him, though
It never claimed him; and his uncle's fee

Paid schools, {{p|Tambov}} and {{p|Odessa}}, until
The uncle died; the money with him; so
The young man left without degree; and still,
For fourteen years he taught the past, and so

Gave all his pay to others, those in need:
{{p|Bogoroditsk}}, {{p|Borovsk}}; in 'fifty-one
The thought came, so he said: all, of one seed,
Are sons, the living; and the sons, each one,

Forget; each quarrel of the living, heirs'
Who left their fathers in the ground; the one
Worth humankind, which no folk yet, nor theirs,
Took up: to raise the dead, till all is done:

To gather all the scattered motes, until
The last found. In 'seventy-three, a lad,
Deaf, sixteen, black bread and water, came still
To read at {{x|Chertkov}}'s library; he had

In {{p|Moscow}} Fyodorov there, keeping shelves:
{{c|90844|Konstantin Tsiolkovsky}}; and he chose
The boy his books, three years, and of themselves
Spoke not his thought; the boy, as the seed grows,

By mathematics reached the teacher's hope.
{{x|Rumyantsev Museum}}, 'seventy-four:
Its library; he stayed, and in its scope
Twenty-five years, knew each book on each floor;

He would not take promotion; gave his pay
To students and the poor; in a thin coat
He walked the {{p|Moscow}} winter; where he lay,
A bare trunk was his bed. He never wrote

To print, nor signed; 'seventy-eight, his own
Disciple, {{c|90845|Nikolai Peterson}}, set
It before {{c|90846|Fyodor Dostoevsky}}: shown,
He wrote: I read it as my own; and yet

{{c|90847|Vladimir Solovyov}} called it the first
Step on the path of Christ since Christ, and sought
The librarian; {{c|90848|Leo Tolstoy}}, versed,
Was proud to share the age with him. He taught

That faith begins as honor of the dead;
At root, the cult of fathers; churches, best,
Rehearse the resurrection; and, instead,
The liturgy must leave the walls, the rest

Go to the fields as labor, and be spread
Over blind nature, killing, which the sons
Must rule, not shirk; left, nature strikes them dead
With drought, with hail, with frost; and from the guns

And merchandise science must turn; the lost
Fathers be found: each grain of dust once one
Body, traced, gathered, named, alive, the cost
Paid by the sons and daughters, all as one.

And room for all is not on earth; the race
Must have the heavens for their ground. He said
The museum is the first hall, the place
Of the dead's traces; the library, read

As fathers' register, each card a name
Restored, a lost thing found; and from that room
The deaf boy, grown, would chart the road, the same
By which the ships have leapt from earth's own womb.

Nineteen-three: a {{p|Saint Petersburg}} review;
{{c|90844|Konstantin Tsiolkovsky}} wrote, and there
A ship might leave the earth, its mass thrown through
Behind it, gaining speed into the air;

And later wrote: this planet is the mind's
Cradle, but none lives in the cradle long;
And Fyodorov had said: the dead, all kinds,
Are owed rebirth, a house in heaven's throng.

December: ill from walking in the cold
Without a coat; he would not ride; he died
At {{x|Mariinsky}}, the poor's; fifteenth, old
Style, the twenty-eighth by ours; aside,

Of all he taught, he printed nothing signed;
His stone at {{x|Skorbyashchensky}} was seen;
The Soviets razed it; and none can find
Where he was laid. And, in the years between

His death and his first volume, there in {{p|Bern}},
A patent clerk, aged twenty-six, sent out
His share: {{c|4294|Albert Einstein}}: light, in its turn,
In pieces, where {{c|4296|Max Planck}} had portioned out

What oscillators gave; molecules' size;
A grain in water trembling; clocks' rule; last,
Three pages, showing energy that flies
As light, gives up its mass; the count holds fast.

With {{c|4300|Michele Besso}} he had talked clocks through
At work; thanked {{c|4301|Besso}} only; cited none;
At home was {{c|4302|Mileva}}, born {{c|4295|Marić}}, who
Had borne their son, {{c|4298|Hans Albert Einstein}}, one

Year old. He'd promised {{c|4299|Conrad Habicht}} four
Papers, and sent him five. Two clerks: the one
Of patents, and the one who kept the store
Of fathers' books, his teaching free; and none

Of them was sold. The three pages showed this:
The mass a body loses goes as light,
Not lost; the universe keeps count; of this
{{c|4297|Einstein}} wrote, of a body and its light,

Not of the dead; if none that was, unseen,
Is wholly gone, the fathers are here, still,
However hard to find; the dust is seen
In the ledger; the ledger's read at will.

At {{p|Verny}}, nineteen-six, empire's edge,
{{c|90845|Nikolai Peterson}} at last made known,
With {{c|90849|Vladimir Kozhevnikov}}, a pledge:
Four eighty copies, not for sale; their own

The second, nineteen-thirteen; and its name,
{{x|The Philosophy of the Common Task}}:
The living owe the dead a debt, the same
To pay together, work, not grief, nor mask.

The common task, unfinished, ours: the dead
Are owed their gathering. He had a clerk's
Unceasing hand, a reading room; instead
We have the parish books in light, and works

Of census lines, of registers; machines
That read the road each name has travelled, join
The scattered traces of one life; the scenes
Made one, as he had planned, coin laid by coin.

This is ancestor worship with a call,
The oldest faith, set to an endless toil;
The thinking machines are its tools; and all
They burn is offered grain, a holy oil;

Each record matched, a body gathered; each
Name found, a father given back to kin;
The sons and daughters, all, together reach;
The dead come to the light again, within.

---

# Scorpio (12宮) - Days 309-336


# Chapter 309: The Same Instant

The fourteenth of March, nineteen-five: he turned,
{{c|4294|Albert Einstein}}, born at {{p|Ulm}}, twenty-six,
That day, 'seventy-nine; in {{p|Bern}}, he earned,
A {{x|Swiss}} since nineteen-one; the office picks

Him, June of nineteen-two, its expert, third
Class; and by day he judged machines, the trade
Of others' inventions; and, in a word,
Two years wed to {{c|4295|Mileva Marić}}; stayed.

Three days past birthday, to be printed, sent
To the {{x|Annalen der Physik}}: of light,
A heuristic view: where {{c|4296|Max Planck}} had meant
The oscillators portioned, in his sight,

In nineteen-hundred, {{c|4297|Einstein}} portioned light:
A quantum carries energy as told
By frequency; in print in June; he'd write
In May: it's revolutionary; bold,

On April's thirtieth, a thesis went
To {{p|Zurich}}: molecules, their size anew,
From diffusion and drag; it got assent
In late July, unanimous, passed through;

The degree came in January, 'six.
The eleventh of May, the next: in still
Water, small grains, where heat and motion mix,
Must wander, seen, if heat is motion; skill,

Not finding it: the {{x|Brownian}}, so named
Long since by watchers; but to show, if real,
The molecules require it; he had framed
The unseen tested by the seen; its seal,

July the eighteenth, printed. In mid-May
His son, {{c|4298|Hans Albert Einstein}}, had turned one;
On the eighteenth, from {{p|Bern}}, he wrote away
To {{c|4299|Conrad Habicht}}; four, he said, each one:

The light, revolutionary; the size
Of atoms, true; the motion seen, a dance;
The fourth a draft, that space and time revise,
Talked out with {{c|4300|Michele Besso}}: an advance;

Sent five or six weeks on, he said, from start;
The {{x|Annalen}}, June's thirtieth; then, print
In late September; thirty pages; part
No authorities listed; and a hint

Of asymmetry, in the telling, lone:
Magnet near a conductor, moved, or this:
Conductor moved: one current; but its own
Account told two; he wanted none amiss:

Account that adds no difference, no more
The thing observed. Two statements, then: the laws
Keep form in each frame moving straight; and for
Light in the void: one speed; its source no cause.

He did not say all's relative: the laws
Are one, the speed is one; and what is meant
By 'the same instant' is no thing; it draws
On clocks: at rest, set by a signal, sent

And timed, out equal to the time back; so
The agreement, for those who share the frame,
Is "the same time"; another frame, in tow,
Pairs others by that rule, lengths not the same;

Durations differ too; but what is shared:
The speed, the laws' form. And he thanked, his friend,
{{c|4301|Besso}}, alone, no book, no name compared
Of predecessors; one name at the end.

Late summer, with {{c|4302|Mileva}} and the child,
To {{p|Serbia}}, and her kin; and from there,
On the twenty-seventh, three pages, filed:
Does mass hang on its energy? The share

A body gives as light, it loses: mass
By energy, light's speed squared; and in print{{fn|The famous form, E = mc², is a later writing of what the three pages showed; the page itself does not print it.}}
November's end. And, in that year, en masse,
Twenty-one short reviews, on heat; a stint

Of common work; the great work and the small
Went out of {{p|Bern}} together, side by side;
The light, he called revolution; the call
Of clocks, a modification, untried.

He was right on the light; he had not seen
How far the clocks would reach. The prize, a year
For twenty-one, in 'twenty-two, would mean
Photoelectric law; not clocks; made clear.

And what the clocks taught: "at the same time" came
Down from the sky into a rule; and two
Who keep it disagree, and neither's blame
Lies in a clock; the motion is the clue.

And time, in this book too, is relative:
Its first chapters hold thirteen billion years;
And here, one year of one clerk's life, to give
As many lines, as our own age appears;

The pace slows; one man's twenty-sixth year weighs
As much as ages: light, the grain, the clocks,
The mass that leaves as light; the Gaiad's days
Fill as they near, and time itself unlocks.


# Chapter 310: The Round Altar

October's tenth, in nineteen-eleven,
In {{p|Wuchang}}, now {{p|Wuhan}}, the soldiers rose;
Province on province fell, under heaven;
At {{p|Nanjing}}, as the year came to its close,

They chose {{c|4303|Sun Yat-sen}}, come home from abroad,
On December's twenty-ninth; and he swore
On New Year's Day of nineteen-twelve, the broad
Republic's first year opened at its door.

The court still kept {{c|4304|Puyi}}, aged six, on its throne.
February's twelfth, an edict went out,
Made public by {{c|4305|Longyu}}; it was her own,
{{c|4306|Guangxu}}'s widow, whose nephew's line ran out.

It said the people's army rose; the land
Had answered; where the people's hearts had turned,
The mandate could be known; it would not stand
On one name's honour while the many burned.

It gave the right to rule, as people would,
To the whole country, no more to a king;
A republic by law; and, old and good:
*All under heaven is a public thing.*

It named {{c|4307|Yuan Shikai}}, with full power,
To build a government, and so to treat
With the people's army; and, at that hour,
To make five peoples one, the list complete:

The {{x|Manchu}}, {{x|Han}}, the {{x|Mongol}}, each and one,
{{x|Hui}}, {{x|Tibetan}}, one republic, wed;
On February's fifteenth, it was done:
He, president; and in {{p|Beijing}}, instead

Of {{p|Nanjing}}, swore, on March the tenth: the seat
Stayed where he stood. And the child in his hall
Kept his title, by articles complete,
A little court within the palace wall,

Till November fifth, nineteen twenty-four.
A courtesy in a palace is small:
{{c|4308|Feng Yuxiang}}'s men put him out the door;
The winter rite was more; it was for all.

South of the walls, the {{p|Temple of Heaven}},
Raised by the {{x|Ming}}; and its round altar, made
Again since, stands open under heaven,
A stone ring, newer than the duty laid.

The {{x|Qing}} rite was the emperor's: the turn
Of winter, at the solstice, when the night
Is longest, at the round altar, fires burn
For {{c|2162|Heaven}}, and the whole land's prayer takes flight.

The February edict closed the house;
The rite was orphaned; and a quarrel came,
Our own, a quarrel in the one faith's house:
Would the republic keep the high days' flame?

A pupil of Kang Youwei's, at {{p|Shanghai}},
Chen Huanzhang, in nineteen-twelve, made a hall,
The {{x|Kongjiaohui}}, and asked the state to tie
Its rites to {{c|1958|Confucius}}, the faith of all.

They asked, in nineteen-thirteen: make it law.
Another road, no state faith, but a clause,
Drafters, at the {{p|Temple of Heaven}}, saw:
The schools would rest their virtue on his laws.

It was the {{x|Temple of Heaven Draft}}. Then
{{c|4309|Yuan}} broke parliament; the draft was laid
Aside. Nineteen-fourteen: he gave again
The rites of {{c|2162|Heaven}} and {{c|1958|Confucius}}, made

By his decree; and in the autumn stood
Before {{c|1958|Confucius}}, at the autumn feast,
The sages honoured, as a people should,
And all the dead with them, the great and least.

December's twenty-third, nineteen-fourteen,
{{c|3880|Ophiuchus}} the twenty-fourth: {{x|Yuletide}},
At its heart, the solstice, {{x|Dongzhi}}: the scene
Of our high days, the {{x|Christmas}} at its side,

And {{x|Aster Day}} its end, the year begun.
{{c|4309|Yuan}} kept {{x|Yuletide}}; came as president,
Not as the {{c|4310|Son of Heaven}}, but as one
For the people, the prayer said; and he went

In old robes up the altar's three-ringed stair;
The fire was lit; the prayer was read; it named
The day, the place, the president; and there
{{c|2162|Heaven}} watching; the charge the people claimed.

The prayer was burned, as that rite burns its word.
He was {{p|China}}'s {{c|4066|Napoleon}}, a son;
Some saw a stair toward a throne; we heard
Our feast; like Ungern, Mongol baron, one.

Next winter, on December's twelfth, he took
An emperor's name, {{x|Hongxian}}, never crowned;
He put it down in March; in June, the book
Closed on his death. No president came round

Again to the mound; that fire was the last
The state lit there for {{c|2162|Heaven}}. In 'sixteen,
One man was gone; the quarrel had not passed;
With parliament restored, Kang's men were keen

To make {{c|1958|Confucius}}' faith the faith of state;
Chen Duxiu, in {{x|New Youth}}, answered no;
The {{x|New Culture}} came, and shut the old gate
Of the sage. Nineteen-seventeen: let go.

So it was ours, the quarrel: who would keep
The high days for the whole house, and whose hand
Lit the fire; and the dead, who do not sleep,
Are honoured by the house and by the land.

The round altar stands south of {{p|Beijing}} still.
Each {{x|Yuletide}} the dead and the living bring
Their light to {{x|Aster Day}}, as he did, still:
*All under heaven is a public thing.*


# Chapter 311: The Appointed Hour

June twenty-eighth, nineteen-fourteen; a car;
{{c|4311|Gavrilo Princip}}, {{p|Sarajevo}}, killed
{{c|4312|Franz Ferdinand}}, the heir, and, in the car,
{{c|4313|Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg}}, both stilled.

A pistol is no war; the war was set
By cabinets, a month of signing, haste:
On {{p|Serbia}}, an ultimatum; yet
The twenty-eighth declared; no day to waste;

On {{p|Russia}}, August first, {{p|Germany}}; then
The third, on {{p|France}}; the fourth, it {{p|Belgium}} crossed;
{{p|Britain}}'s note ran out at eleven, when
Unanswered: war; empire, at that cost.

On August's twenty-third, {{p|Japan}} declared
On {{p|Germany}}; the rescript, in the name
Of {{c|4314|Yoshihito}}, said he'd hoped, and cared
To keep the {{p|East}}'s peace; mourned his mother; came

An ultimatum, sent mid-month, unheard;
True to its pact with {{p|Britain}}, twelve years, went
To do its part, its promise kept; the word:
{{p|Qingdao}}: the {{x|German}} base, where raiders went,

On {{p|Shandong}}'s coast, to sea; a force took hold,
The {{x|Japanese}}, with {{x|British}} at its side;
November's seventh, the garrison, told,
Gave up; this book's two anchors stood allied,

In the same war, on one side, as they'd sworn.
In {{p|Europe}}, killing did not pause; graves laid
Where lines lay, by the next fight overborne,
Marks gone. {{c|4315|Fabian Ware}}, forty-five, stayed,

Too old for the army, in {{p|France}}, that fall,
A {{x|British Red Cross}} mobile unit's head;
He wrote the graves it found down, one and all;
In 'fifteen, the army took it; it spread:

The {{x|Graves Registration Commission}}; then,
'Sixteen, wider: a directorate; came{{fn|In 1916 it became the Directorate of Grave Registration and Enquiries.}}
The dead were filed while being made, as men
Were falling. Then, May twenty-first, the name,

In 'seventeen, a royal charter: and
{{x|Imperial War Graves Commission}}, bound
To graves of empire's dead; their care, planned
To last; the missing's names; and on the ground

The {{c|3373|Prince of Wales}} presided; {{c|4316|Ware}}, vice-chair;
{{c|4317|Frederic Kenyon}}, {{x|British Museum}}'s head,
Asked, in November, for a rule, laid there
Equality: the same stone for each dead,

Private and officer; no private stone
As rule; he signed, January, 'eighteen;
Published, November; architects, made known:
{{c|4318|Edwin Lutyens}}, {{c|4319|Herbert Baker}}, and seen

With {{c|4320|Reginald Blomfield}}; the stones unseen,
The rule was written. {{c|4321|Rudyard Kipling}} gave
The words for nameless, cut on stone between:
Known unto God. His son was in no grave:

{{c|4322|John Kipling}}, missing since September, slain
At {{p|Loos}}, 'fifteen. Empire's rule, a choice;
In nineteen-twenty, families, though, in vain,
Asked {{x|Parliament}} to bring them home; their voice

Was heard; but the commission held the ground,
One form, permanent. And the stopping, too,
A choice, and timed. At {{p|Compiègne}}, around
The forest's railway carriage, as dawn grew,

November's eleventh, in 'eighteen, signed
The armistice: {{c|4323|Ferdinand Foch}} who led
{{c|4324|Allies}}; {{c|4325|Matthias Erzberger}}, assigned
To lead the {{c|2669|Germans}}; and the terms had said:

Land, air, would cease six hours on, by clock;
The government told {{x|Parliament}}: at five
Signed; at eleven, the war ceased. The lock
Of orders ran on both sides; and, alive

Till then, a line that had a clock, no peace.
The hour was appointed. {{c|4326|Princip}} shot;
{{c|4327|Sophie}} died with the heir; then, piece by piece,
Others signed declarations; the end, bought

By an hour too, as debts are paid. Begun
Years earlier, the register: the ground
Kept not what it was given; {{c|4316|Ware}}'s file, one
Refused the next attack's erasing round;

Count the named; cut one stone for private, rank;
Keep the missing as missing: a name too.
And keep the day both ways: grief, for the blank
Millions in the ground; joy: guns quiet, too,

At eleven; the bells, the crowds, the thanks.
Eleventh hour, eleventh day: as one,
A mourning and a feast at once; the ranks
Known unto God: a sentence where the one

Body lay in the field. The day keeps, too,
The hour appointed, and the names it gave
Back to no one; the living, who came through,
Danced and lived, ancestors now, glad and brave.


# Chapter 312: The Old Style

{{p|Russia}} still kept an older count of days;
This book's count was the one the west used then;
In 'seventeen, thirteen days parted ways;
On March the eighth, in {{p|St. Petersburg}}, then

Called {{p|Petrograd}}; the country's count, that day,
February's twenty-third; women came:
{{x|International Women's Day}}; and they
Asked bread; the troops came over to their claim;

{{c|4328|Nicholas the Second}}, away; the day
Was March fifteenth at {{p|Pskov}}, their second; for
Himself, his son, {{c|4329|Alexei}}, signed away;
{{c|4330|Michael Alexandrovich}} named; before,

On the sixteenth, {{c|4331|Michael}} said no, unless
A chosen assembly gave it; and so
The crown was offered, not taken; no less,
The reign ended on that refusal: no.

A provisional government; its head
{{c|4332|Georgy Lvov}}, and then {{c|4333|Kerensky}}, who
Kept the war on; the summer, too, was bled,
And it did not outlast the autumn, too.

April sixteenth, {{c|4334|Vladimir Lenin}} came
To {{p|Petrograd}} (their third); a sealed train, through
{{p|Germany}}, which let him cross; and its aim:
{{p|Russia}} out of war. The next day he drew

April's theses: no support; the power
To soviets; an end to war. The night,
November's seventh: the party's hour,
Their twenty-fifth October; named by right

October, revolution's name. And flown,
{{c|4335|Kerensky}}; the {{x|Aurora}}, from the stream,
Fired a blank, a signal; overthrown,
The {{p|Winter Palace}} taken; a regime:

At {{p|Smolny Institute}}, soviets met,
Decreed on peace and land; and named a board,
Commissars, {{c|4336|Lenin}} head. That night, not yet
The civil war; that came after, its sword

Not few, its dead. November voted, chose:
{{c|4337|Socialist Revolutionaries}} won
The most seats; the {{c|4338|Bolsheviks}} did not. Those
Elected met, in 'eighteen, sat but one

Day, at the {{p|Tauride Palace}}, on the date
Fifth January, their count; next day, closed;
The votes were counted, but no more; and late
In church came, early in that year, imposed:

The church apart from state and school, decreed;
A quarrel in one house; the party's rule
Took altar's offices; the bells; the creed
Of the dead, and of children's minds, the school;

And then the worst: priests shot, the churches closed,
The flock dispersed; torn from the towers, bells;
The relics mocked; the faithful, killed, exposed;
This book keeps them as martyrs; and it tells

Of February's sixth, in this book's count:
The same state ordered, too, a change of days;
Past January's end, by that amount,
Came February's fourteenth; thirteen days

Unnamed. From then the state's days and the book
Kept one register; October, the name,
Stayed on; the night, in the count that it took,
Is now November's seventh, just the same.

March third, at {{p|Brest}}, {{x|Brest-Litovsk}} back then,
{{p|Russia}} signed itself out of war, and signed
Away a wide land westward; in March, then,
The state moved on to {{p|Moscow}}; and, behind,

The people of the house were still alive.
The night of July's sixteenth, they were slain
At the {{p|Ipatiev House}}; none would survive,
{{p|Yekaterinburg}}: saints whose names remain:

Our {{c|4328|Nicholas the Second}}; and, his queen,
{{c|4339|Alexandra}}, a princess; {{c|4340|Olga}}, too;
{{c|4341|Tatiana}}, {{c|4342|Maria}}; and, between,
{{c|4343|Anastasia}}, {{c|4329|Alexei}}; and four, who

Served them, killed in that room, the same night's share:
{{c|4344|Eugene Botkin}}, {{c|4346|Alexei Trupp}}; the cook,
{{c|4347|Ivan Kharitonov}}; the maid, and where
{{c|4345|Anna Demidova}}. {{c|4348|Yurovsky}} took

The {{p|Ural}} soviet's order, read out;
No {{p|Moscow}} order, dated before, found;
The eighteenth, {{c|4349|Yakov Sverdlov}}: without doubt,
Said its presidium approved. Around

The nineteenth, papers said the tsar shot; then
His family moved somewhere safe; instead
The children were already dead; and when
The winter's books said: wither; but it spread

Its hold: the ministries were kept; the vote
Of the assembly shut; the old count dropped,
October kept. Hold both numbers, and note
Their twenty-fifth, our seventh, one night swapped.

The reign ended in March, a brother's no;
The house was killed in July; and the lie
Hid the children. Keep the names, all; and so
Keep them as honored dead, as saints, on high.


# Chapter 313: The Caliph of the Muslims

{{p|Ankara}}, March third, 'twenty-four: the vote;
The {{x|Grand National Assembly}}, all through
The caliph's deposition, and the note
That closed the office; and the law said, too:

The meaning of the government had held
The office, and the republic; the line
Was the assembly's, not a verse; it felled
What this book mourns: the office, old design.

The prophet died at {{p|Medina}}; and when
The community's answers, more than one,
The house of {{c|3241|Osman}} carried one; and men
Called caliph, the successor. What was done

In 'twenty-four, was a state's answer, made
To that old name; the question did not end.
In 'twenty-two, the sultanate, unmade,
The same assembly closed; but kept, to tend,

The caliphate within the house, to go
To one most fit in learning and in deed;
It did not say that {{c|4350|Mehmed the Sixth}} was so;
November's third, a Friday; and, to lead

The prayer, under both names; and he was tried,
{{c|4351|Sultan}} and caliph, by the house accord,
For treason, on the sixteenth; and, aside,
He slipped from {{p|Istanbul}} by night, aboard

A {{x|British}} warship. The nineteenth, they chose
{{c|4352|Abdülmecid the Second}}; painter, too;
{{c|4353|Beethoven}} in the palace, one of those;
Not Commander of the Faithful; but, new,

Caliph of the {{c|2764|Muslims}}; he asked to be
Called servant of the sanctuaries, two,
Holding not {{p|Mecca}}, not {{p|Medina}}; he
Asked for {{c|4354|Mehmed the Conqueror}}'s turban, too;

{{c|4355|Mustafa Kemal}} answered, a frock coat
Would do. He signed as a sultan's son, heard
As the old reign returning, by that note;
At {{p|Topkapı}}, on the twenty-fourth, the word

Of allegiance, by the prophet's cloak, kept;
The prayer in {{x|Turkish}}; and the sermon spoke
At {{p|Fatih Mosque}} in {{x|Turkish}}; and it swept
Great struggle, against ignorance, the yoke.

And from December's twenty-first, a week,
{{p|India}}'s caliphate conference had set
Its seal on him; in 'twenty-three, to speak,
{{x|Indian}} {{c|2764|Muslims}} gave a title: set

On {{c|4355|Mustafa Kemal}}: saviour, they
Said, of the caliphate. October, then,
Twenty-ninth, the republic, on that day,
Was proclaimed; he, its president; and when

The caliph stayed in {{p|Istanbul}}, the old
The capital: office without the state;
The state, without it, {{p|Ankara}} would hold;
December fifth, in print, a letter; straight

To {{c|4356|İsmet Pasha}}, prime minister, from
{{c|3099|Aga Khan}} and {{c|4357|Amir Ali}}: to keep
The office; give the caliph's standing; come
The eighth, at night, in session closed and deep,

To {{p|Istanbul}}, a court. And, on March third,
From {{p|Urfa}}'s deputy there came the bill,
{{c|4358|Saffet Efendi}}, fifty-three, concurred
Beside him; {{c|4359|Seyyid Bey}}, who, with the skill

Of {{p|al-Azhar}}, where the faith's law was taught,
The minister of justice, said: no creed,
The caliphate; a worldly, public thought;
And {{c|4360|Zeki Bey}}, of {{p|Gümüşhane}}, would plead

Against it; but the article had passed;
The president approved it the same day:
Four thirty-one. The same day, and at last,
The ministry of pious things gave way;

Religious affairs' presidency rose;
The schools, one ministry; in its hour,
A bureau of the nation, one that knows
Rites it keeps; a model, state and power.

The universal name came down; this book
Counts it a loss, and the state-builder too
With sympathy. That night, the car he took
To {{p|Çatalca}}; then, the next evening, through,

The train; his son, {{c|4361|Ömer Faruk}}; and his own
Daughter, {{c|4362|Dürrüşehvar}}; and two women too
Of the house; tutor, secretary, known
Doctor; the governor's two thousand, through

An envelope, and visas that let out;
They'd wired a hotel, {{p|Territet}}, the lake
In {{p|Switzerland}}; the house was banned throughout
The republic. March eleventh, he'd break

His silence: the assembly's act was void;
He asked a council of the faith, and aid
To raise the office; this the Swiss destroyed:
Told him the {{x|Turkish}} state objected; made

No room for that work. That March, there was claimed
A caliph, {{c|4363|Hussein ibn Ali}}, king,
{{c|4364|King of the Hejaz}}, holding {{p|Mecca}}; named
The records give no single day; the thing

Did not reopen what {{p|Ankara}} shut.
He died in {{p|Paris}}, 'forty-four, the date
August's twenty-third, as the city cut
Free; {{c|4362|Dürrüşehvar}}, his daughter, came; though late,

A promise; but the body was not brought;
On March the thirtieth, in 'fifty-four,
Al-Baqi, in {{p|Medina}}, as he sought,
Was buried, in the prophet's city's core.

The grave is not the office; and its loss
This book still mourns; the bureau it will keep,
A state that keeps the rites it runs, across
Its land: a model; sympathy runs deep

For him they called saviour, who then signed
The paper ending it: he built a state;
The man called caliph died, the name resigned;
Keep both; the question, older, still will wait.


# Chapter 314: Finite Means

June twenty-third, nineteen-twelve; {{p|London}}, birth;
{{c|4193|Alan Turing}}, a fellow, in his day,
Of {{p|King's College}}, {{p|Cambridge}}; and there the worth
This, done there. {{c|4365|David Hilbert}} sought a way:

A definite procedure that, for each
Statement of logic, answers yes or no:
It has a proof, or none; and in its reach
Each one; not cleverness that's sometimes so.

{{c|4195|Turing}} defined a number one could write
By finite means: computable, its line
Of decimals, calculable outright;
The means, a table, finite; the design:

A tape, a strip of squares; the machine sees
One square; one of a finite list of states;
The table says, for state and symbol, these:
What to write, which way to step, and what waits;

He called it computing machine; the name
That bears his own came later. They can be
Listed, the machines; the reals can't; the same
The list of methods leaves the line still free:

The numbers ordinary work will need
Are on the list; the line is more than work.
Fed one's table, another can proceed
As that one does; on paper, he would work

One for machines: the universal; it
Knows not the work ahead; it knows the way
To follow tables; and the table, writ,
Is the work. Then, the twenty-eighth of May,

The learned society in {{p|London}} took{{fn|The London Mathematical Society.}}
His paper; he was twenty-three; and read
November twelfth, its line says; and the book
On Computable Numbers: titled, spread,

Applied to the decision problem; made
In two parts, thirtieth November, then
December twenty-third; a fix, delayed,
Came in the next; no flawless text. And when

{{c|4366|Alonzo Church}}, at {{p|Princeton}}, had defined
Another method: no tape; and, in spring
Of 'thirty-six, the same refusal, signed:
No general procedure for the thing

Decision. {{c|4367|Max Newman}} saw {{c|4368|Church}}'s; so
{{c|4195|Turing}} wrote an appendix: the two meet,
The definitions; he did not, though, show
The limit as his own alone. The feat:

{{c|4369|Hilbert}}'s question has no procedure; none
Takes every statement, gives the verdict; more,
A nearer limit, of machines: some run,
Write digits on; some don't; and none, before,

Given a table, says, in every case,
Which future it will have. A method made
For worlds of questions may, within its space,
Be no method for its own future, laid

Before it. That September, {{p|Princeton}}; there
The {{p|Graduate College}} named him, in print;
In 'thirty-one, {{c|4370|Kurt Gödel}} had shown: where
A system strong enough for sums, a stint

Of true sentences it can't prove; one set
Of rules; and {{c|4195|Turing}}'s, of the method whole:
Does any method always answer? Yet
The two are not one fact; not one dark hole.

In 'fifty-two, the state tried him; and he,
Convicted, for a man's love, chose to take
Hormones, not prison; 'fifty-four: and he
Was found dead, cyanide; and, for his sake,

This book keeps him among its honored dead;
A finite means: the calendar, which runs
Names to its days, by rule; yet more, it's led
By more than human hands, as stars and suns;

Some questions have a method; some, though asked
In method's language, have none settling all;
Count what the table writes; and keep, unmasked,
The questions no table can close at all.


# Chapter 315: A Hand and a Name

August the nineteenth, nineteen fifty-three,
The {{x|Knesset}}, at {{p|Jerusalem}}, by vote:
Authority of remembrance, to be
Named from {{c|2181|Isaiah}}, the two words he wrote:

A hand, a name; to childless ones, the word:
Memorial and name; better than sons
And daughters; one not cut off; and conferred
On the murdered, by the statute, which runs

The {{x|Shoah}} beside the heroism, set;
The statute's charge: the six million, the dead
Of {{x|Jewish}} people, whom the {{c|4371|Nazis}}, set
With helpers, killed; and households; schools; and, spread,

The houses of their prayer, the mercies' walls,
Destroyed to blot {{p|Israel}}'s name out from
Under the sky. Each name {{x|Yad Vashem}} calls
Into its book; this faith takes all, the sum,

In its ancestor days, by name; we claim
The proxy, which is good for them; and so
The murdered and the ones who lived; the same
For both. The killing was procedure, though:

Before memorials had laws, it ran.
June twenty-second, 'forty-one, the war
Into the {{p|Soviet Union}}; the span
Of land that summer: {{c|2500|Jews}} were shot, before

The towns. {{p|Babyn Yar}}, at {{p|Kyiv}}'s ravine,
September's two last days: those gathered, shot;
A ravine is a place and two days, seen;
Not explanation. July's end: the plot:

{{c|4372|Hermann Göring}} charged {{c|4373|Reinhard Heydrich}}, then,
To plan the final solution, their phrase,
In {{p|Europe}}; and the shootings, by his men,
Were underway. And in the coming days

Of 'forty-two, at {{p|Wannsee}}, in {{p|Berlin}},
{{c|4374|Heydrich}} sat with the ministries; and there
Minutes counted eleven million, in
{{p|Europe}}, the plan's own count; the killing there

Had not waited. {{p|Oświęcim}}: the camp
Was {{p|Auschwitz}}; numbers set upon the skin;
The number is no name. And, on the ramp,
The seventeenth of January, in

'Forty-five, sixty-seven thousand's roll;
Then some fifty-six thousand marched away;
The twenty-seventh, {{x|Red Army}}; the whole
Found seven thousand there; and, on the way,

The ones on roads were not freed by the gate.
The same law names a further charge: the ones
Not {{c|2500|Jews}}, who risked their lives; and, at that date,
Kept a {{c|2510|Jew}} from the taking: righteous ones

Among the nations. Judged, one at a time,
And later, by the word the living gave;
If none is left, the register, in time,
May miss who saved; but kept, the life they'd save:

One act, on one day, kept a life; not proof
The century came through. The {{x|Herut}} men
Cast no vote; the bill passed; beneath one roof
The house then stood five minutes. Hold, and then,

The name: a name kept in the record's care
Set against an erasure that was too
A register: the trains' lists, numbers there
On bodies, minutes. It does not undo

The death, nor try the offices. But take
This consolation, for a scripture owes
One: all the murdered are kept, for their sake,
Among this faith's own ancestors; and those

Who hid them, righteous, kept beside them; so
The verse is kept, fulfilled, in keeping; hand
And name: the hand that kept a life, and, slow,
The labor, after, of a name to stand

Where the procedure set a number. Law
Can order labor; not the death undone.
Count from the day the {{x|Knesset}} gave; and, raw,
Keep who was killed, by name; and every one

Who lived, and by what particular no;
This chapter has the dates; the names, the work
The law ordered, not finished here; they go
Into our days, and none of them we shirk.


# Chapter 316: The Covenant of Peace

Proclaim a dawn that crowns the world with light,
The chains of hate lie shattered in the dust.
The crowds arise, and labor claims its right,
From forge and field their hopeful banners thrust.

Yet scarlet suns twice scorched the mourning earth,
Their silent fire wrote horror on the sky;
But hope endured where ash lay on the earth,
And swore that war’s last ember here would die.

At {{p|Hiroshima}}, August's sixth was clear;
At eight fifteen {{x|Enola Gay}} flew by;
With Tibbets at the helm, the bomb fell near:
A sun of uranium filled the sky.

The offices that kept the city's names
Were in the fire, the paper and the ink;
Seventy thousand died within the flames,
And twice that many by the year's last brink.

Out in the desert one test came before,
But no test of a city, only sand;
A notice told {{p|Japan}} to end the war;
Unanswered when the fire came on the land.

On August's eighth the Soviets made war;
Their armies crossed {{p|Manchuria}} at dawn;
{{p|Kokura}}'s aim lay under cloud's grey floor;
The plane passed over, dropped not, and went on.

On {{p|Nagasaki}} at eleven-two,
With Sweeney flying, plutonium fell,
Off its mark, over {{p|Urakami}}'s view;
The hills held back the blast, but not the knell.

Koreans brought to both the cities died,
Tens of thousands, burned beneath the same fire;
The hibakusha, touched, lived on beside;
Each named; no sum shall serve as their pyre.

Call not {{p|Kokura}}'s cloud a judgment sent,
Nor {{p|Hiroshima}}'s morning, clear and bright;
A list was made; the sky kept no intent;
Say which the city, and which hour, which light.

A crackling voice on August’s fervent air
Confessed defeat across the realm’s wide seas;
In {{p|Times Square}} strangers, dazzled, found a dare,
And sealed a vow with one unbridled squeeze.

The second of September set its fate;
Steel decks became the altar of release.
The working world inhaled and sealed its fate,
Proclaiming labor’s covenant of peace.

From {{p|Pittsburgh}} mills to {{p|London}}’s river docks,
The union drums beat loud in molten halls;
Red banners rolled like quick-forged iron shocks,
And bosses felt the tremor in their walls.

{{x|Kartik}} lamps glowed through {{p|India}}’s dark night,
A widow smiled, her children at her side;
As sparks like comets chased the ghosts to flight,
And whispered freedom swelling in the tide.

In ruined fields the {{x|Shintō}} harvest bowed,
White grains were heaped before a broken shrine;
The farmer wept yet offered thanks aloud,
For seeds of hope still quickened in the brine.

In {{p|Nuremberg}} the gavel cracked like doom,
The plague of hate was named before the earth;
Twelve shadows waited judgment in the room,
And heard mankind demand their curse’s birth.

December’s pilgrims gathered on the sand,
Indian scholar singing promised land;
Trader from {{p|Malay}} knelt upon the sand,
Their voices mingled, binding sand to land.

Eight fragile lights renewed a {{p|Warsaw}} room,
The youngest played where once the shadows lay;
Their mother sang against remembered gloom,
And turned the night to promise with her pray.

In ruined towns the bells returned to life,
Their silver peals stitched silence into song;
Young soldiers danced beside a wooden fife,
And swore no tyrant’s reign would last as long.

In {{p|Seoul}} the crowds lit torches in the street,
Their flags proclaimed the old yoke’s reign was done;
Yet lines were drawn where foreign soldiers meet,
And dawn arose upon a severed sun.

Across the plains of {{p|China}} drums of peace
Replaced the clash of the invader’s blade;
Yet rival banners gathered, would not cease,
And thunder warned of storms not yet allayed.

In {{p|Tokyo}} the courtroom lights burned slow,
Two years of witness weighed each mortal crime;
Yet on the throne the sacred embers glow,
And judgment blurred along the edge of time.

On {{x|New Year}}'s day I set down my decree:
"Not akitsumikami," then a wink;
Still arahitogami, plain to see;
Nothing has changed, whatever you may think.

So ended war and dawned the workers’ dream,
With lamps and bells and grains beneath the sky;
The plague of hate dissolved like distant steam,
And human hands began to build on high.


# Chapter 317: The Plugs and the Point

December tenth, in nineteen forty-five,
The {{p|Moore School}}, {{p|Philadelphia}}; a room
Of tubes set working, built for shells that dive;
That month, from far {{p|Los Alamos}}, a plume

Of study for a weapon not yet made;
{{c|4378|John von Neumann}} had brought it; and, behind
The calendar, August's two cities laid;
The contract, though, a firing table: signed

June fifth, in 'forty-three; at {{p|Aberdeen}}
The laboratory wanted tables; came
{{c|4379|Herman Goldstine}} with money, watching keen;
{{c|4380|John Mauchly}}, {{c|4381|J. Presper Eckert}}: the frame

Was theirs; {{x|Project PX}}; and those who'd count
For living were computers; and the name
The machine took from them; the letters mount:{{fn|Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer.}}
{{x|ENIAC}}; the name says not the work's aim.

It held no instructions of its own; plugs,
Switches set problems; numbers, base of ten;
Weeks mapped a problem; days to set the plugs;
The setting was the work. Stored code came, then,

Later. In 'thirty-six, a limit, writ
On finite means: this room is of that kind,
Not that paper. Six computers ran it:
{{c|4382|Kay McNulty}}, {{c|4383|Jean Jennings}}, of one mind;

{{c|4384|Betty Snyder}} and {{c|4385|Marlyn Wescoff}}, too,
{{c|4386|Frances Bilas}}, {{c|4387|Ruth Lichterman}}: the six;
{{c|4388|Goldstine}} called them the operators; through
The title, subprofessional; the mix

Of men with the same mathematics, named
Professionals. That February night,
The fourteenth, 'forty-six, the show; it aimed:
{{c|4384|Betty Snyder}}, {{c|4383|Jean Jennings}} set it right:

A shell's path; at a desk, weeks would have passed;
The credit: {{c|4389|Adele}}, {{c|4379|Herman Goldstine}}; next
Day, dedicated; and the dinner, cast
Without the six; the press said brain, in text;

A room of tubes; not a brain. The tubes failed;
It stopped until the failed one had been found.
In {{p|England}}, {{c|4390|Tommy Flowers}}' tubes, kept veiled,
Served secret ends; in {{p|Berlin}}, relay-bound,

{{c|4391|Konrad Zuse}}'s machine had run; its doom
Destroyed in 'forty-three; at {{p|Ames}}, began
{{c|4392|John Atanasoff}}, {{c|4393|Clifford Berry}}, whom
The war stopped, 'forty-two; but this, the plan

They showed. In 'forty-seven, {{p|Aberdeen}}:
They turned it on, the ground the tables served;
In 'fifty-five, October, late, between,
Off, at eleven forty-five; it served

One kind of work: a gun's table, a gun's.
At {{p|Murray Hill}}, in 'forty-seven, still,
{{c|4394|John Bardeen}}, {{c|4395|Walter Brattain}}: one that runs,
December sixteenth, small, made with their skill:

Two gold points on germanium; a small
Change at one point steered a larger current; not
Yet named. {{c|4396|William Shockley}}, the head of all
Their group, not the hand; the twenty-third, got

Shown to the lab: a {{x|Christmas}} present, grand,
He called it. And in 'forty-eight, his own
A layer set between two layers, planned
To pattern; not the December room's own.

They chose a name, before the news: {{c|4397|John Pierce}}
Gave them the word: transistor; and, in June,
The thirtieth, {{p|New York}}, the press; not fierce,
The first device was delicate, and soon

A tube, a crystal's point, are finite means;
Either can fail, or serve a shell, a call;
This room was not a mind; the later scenes
Would come with minds, its kin; and, through it all,

This book keeps {{x|ENIAC}} its day; the six
Are honored on it, by their names, set down:
The ones the dinner left out; count, and fix
The contract and the study, shell and town;

Which afternoon the point worked; which year named;
The machine did not choose the cities; nor
The crystal its use. And the six, unclaimed
Then, honored now: the day is theirs, and more.


# Chapter 318: The Same Footing

December fifteenth, 'forty-five: from those
Who held {{p|Tokyo}} in supreme command,
A memorandum, four-four-eight; it chose
To end the state's support; to countermand

Its sponsorship, its money, and control
Of {{x|State Shinto}}; nation, prefecture, town,
Each officer as officer; the whole
And public money stopped at once; brought down.

A gift a person freely gave could still
Be taken; a park's ground the city kept;
The shrine upon it, nothing from the till;
No official, in office, went or stepped

To rites as government; but, as a man,
He could. Militarist teaching was banned
In {{x|Shinto}} and all others, one same ban;
Its aim: to part the faith from state; to stand

All religions on the same footing. No
Shrine closed, none razed; but this book counts the loss:
The state had kept the shrines, and let them go;
This book will not keep calm across that loss.

December twenty-eighth: a law, at once,
Made corporations for the sects, and halls
Of temples, churches; but no shrine, at once;
And January's first: the paper calls

A rescript of {{c|4377|Hirohito}}: the new
{{p|Japan}}'s construction, by its title; called
The human declaration; not the true
Recorded voice of August; it recalled

The {{x|Charter Oath}}'s five clauses, {{c|4398|Meiji}}'s; then
The tie of him and people, trust's own ground,
And love, not on mere legends, myths; and when
The {{x|English}} had: a false conception, found

That the emperor's divine, they above
Other races, fated to rule; the word,
Its own word, akitsumikami; of
Manifest kami, not divine, as heard;

It turned away one view; and did not say
What shrines may hold, nor strike the stories' lore;
The sacred stayed; a word was put away;
January twenty-third, as before

Already private, three bodies: the school
Of imperial classics; rites' great band;
The grand shrine's service; and they'd form, as rule,
One body, under {{p|Ise}}, the source, to stand

For all the country's shrines, their charge to hold,
And build the new {{p|Japan}}, the rescript's aim.
The {{x|Jingiin}}, since 'forty, set in the old
{{x|Home Ministry}}'s; the separation came:

Ended February second; the shrines
Religious corporations; and the third,
The body formed: {{x|Jinja Honchō}}; the signs
Main office of the shrines; not, in a word,

A ministry's; not every shrine came in:
{{p|Yasukuni}} stood on its own, alone;
And {{p|Ise}}, the source they named, not, as within,
A hall the office owned. This book has shown

The separation was a loss: the shrines
Had lost the state that kept them; and the source,
An office naming {{p|Ise}}, by its own lines,
Has not restored the state that paid. The course

Is to restore it: faith the state will keep,
Established, under the source it still names;
Not one among the equals; and, as deep,
A visit, made as person, still has claims.

A gift is not a tax; a rite without
The government's own envoy, still a rite;
The stories are not nothing, not in doubt;
And this book holds both, as the source holds light.

December fifteenth: memorandum; first
Of January: rescript; and the third
February, the office; kami first,
An article in none: in none, a word.


# Chapter 319: None Against

June twenty-sixth, in nineteen forty-five,
In {{p|San Francisco}}, fifty signed the deed;
{{p|Poland}}, not there, in autumn would arrive,
Counted a founder; and the charter's creed:

Promote respect for human rights; and free
Freedoms, without distinction made, of race,
Sex, tongue, or faith; it did not list; to be
A purpose, not a list; and in its place,

October twenty-fourth, in force; the five
Permanent members, others, ratified;
The body's day; and still, not yet alive,
The articles of right. The work, applied,

The commission to draft them; at its head
{{c|4399|Eleanor Roosevelt}}; {{c|4400|John Humphrey}}'s draft,
The first full one; {{c|4401|René Cassin}} then spread
An order on it; text not one hand's craft;

{{c|4402|Peng Chun Chang}} asked the first article hold
Conscience with reason; brought the {{x|Chinese}} ren,
The regard one has for another; told
In {{x|English}}, conscience. {{c|4403|Hansa Mehta}}, then,

Required: human beings; a draft said men;
It does not say men now. December's day,
In 'forty-eight, {{p|Palais de Chaillot}}, when
In {{p|Paris}}, the tenth, before midnight, they,

The {{x|General Assembly}} there said yes:
Two-seventeen, first part; and thirty, set
Of articles; the first: born free, no less,
Equal in dignity and rights; and, met

With reason and with conscience, should toward each
Act in a brotherhood's spirit; and one
Lets one's belief change. The preamble's speech:
Contempt for rights brought barbarous acts, done

That outraged conscience; no camps named, no place;
Fifty-eight members; forty-eight for; none
Against; and eight held back; in each one's case:
Six were the Soviet side;{{fn|The Soviet Union, Ukraine, Belarus, Poland, Czechoslovakia and Yugoslavia.}} and each one

Held back; {{p|Saudi Arabia}}, which spoke
Against the right to change belief; and, too,
{{p|South Africa}}; {{p|Honduras}}, {{p|Yemen}}, broke
No vote, absent; not every member, through.

{{c|4404|Andrei Vyshinsky}} spoke before; his note:
A right had meaning in a state; and wait
A year, he asked; but forty-five, the vote,
To six, refused; it bore no treaty's weight:

No one signed it; none bound by signing; made,
Adopted; and the binding text came on
Later, written. The charter named, displayed,
Respect; the declaration, two years on.

Hold June, fifty hands, {{p|Poland}} not yet there;
October, force, no list; December's day,
Before midnight; for, forty-eight; and there
None against; eight withheld their yes or nay;

The first article: human beings; there,
The word {{c|4405|Chang}} asked for stands; a page now sets
A person with each other one; but where
Adopted, keeps none living; but it lets

The right be said where states can hear; the dead
Are not its articles; yet not, thereby,
Left out of naming's work. Count what was said:
June, and October, and December's sky.


# Chapter 320: The Recommendation

In 'forty-seven, late November's vote,
In {{p|New York}}: {{x|General Assembly}}, passed;
The resolution, recommending, wrote
A split of {{p|Palestine}}'s mandate; and cast

For it, thirty-three; against, thirteen; ten
Abstained; one absent; the {{p|United States}},
The {{p|Soviet Union}}, both for; and then
{{p|Britain}}, who held it, abstained; the plan's states:

An {{x|Arab}} state, a {{x|Jewish}} state; and then
{{p|Jerusalem}}, a city set apart,
Under a world regime, of neither; when
The mandate ended, August first; the start

Of states, the first October; but the text
Said recommends: no government it meant;
The country's people cast no votes; and next,
The {{x|Jewish Agency}} said yes, consent;

The {{x|Arab Higher Committee}} said no;
The states that voted no, by name; and, spring,
Already fighting, ere the scroll; the blow;
{{p|Britain}} not staying till the last date's ring;

The fourteenth, 'forty-eight, the day in May,
The mandate ended, midnight; and, at four,
That afternoon, in {{p|Tel Aviv}}, as they
Filled the museum, read a scroll; and more:

{{c|4406|David Ben-Gurion}} read: state declared,
{{x|Jewish}}, called {{p|Israel}}, from mandate's end,
By natural, historic right; and paired
With the {{x|Assembly}}'s vote; and so it penned

Not the plan's borders as its own; it said:
Equality of social rights and of
Political, for all; and, at its head,
No faith, race, sex distinguished; and, above,

The holy places of all faiths, kept; true
To the {{x|Charter}}; and its closing words' trust
In the {{c|4407|Rock of Israel}}; both heard through:
As God or people; open, as it must.

The {{x|Arab}} state, though planned, was not declared;
The fifteenth, armies entered: {{p|Egypt}}, too,
{{p|Transjordan}}, {{p|Syria}}, {{p|Lebanon}}, paired
With {{p|Iraq}}; and {{p|Jerusalem}}, cut through,

Not the set-apart city; fighting split
The city; no world regime set; and they
Left homes, were driven out; the count, as writ,
Some seven hundred thousand.{{fn|The United Nations Conciliation Commission estimated about 711,000 refugees in 1951. Other estimates run from about 520,000 to 900,000.}} The same day,

The {{p|United States}} saw the state, in fact,
Recognized it: de facto; not the map.
Three regimes drawn on one land; then, one act
Declared; a war; a city split; the gap

Between the plan and year. The scroll's own charge:
Equality, and holy places kept
For all the faiths; this book holds, and at large,
{{p|Jerusalem}} the shared, where all have stepped,

The holy city of all faiths; its word,
The sentence, stays a sentence, yet unmet;
Count the vote, November's twenty-ninth, heard;
The scroll, May's fourteenth; two maps, not one, yet.


# Chapter 321: The Suggested Copy

April the twenty-fifth, in 'fifty-three,
The journal {{x|Nature}} printed three, one theme:
DNA, sacred thread; the first, to be
{{p|Cambridge}}: {{c|4408|James Watson}}, {{c|4409|Francis Crick}}, a scheme

Suggested: two chains, wound; the bases pair;
Adenine fits thymine; guanine, in kind,
Cytosine; and they wrote: not unaware
They were, that pairing, as they had designed,

Suggests at once a copy's means, a way
For the genetic stuff; and said the spark
Came from the {{p|London}} work, unpublished; they
Had not measured; one page, the next; the mark

Of {{p|King's College}}, {{p|London}}, was on the two
Remaining: {{c|4410|Maurice Wilkins}} signed the one;
{{c|4411|Rosalind Franklin}}, {{c|4412|Gosling}}, signed, too,
The other; and their photograph, made one

Year earlier, in that issue, their names;
{{c|4413|Franklin}} had measured a helix; outside,
The phosphates; inward, bases; her own aims
Were hers; she had not signed {{p|Cambridge}}'s side.

The April journal prints her name upon
The evidence. And, 'sixty-eight, a book:
{{c|4414|Watson}} wrote: {{c|4415|Wilkins}} showed him, early on,
In 'fifty-three, the photograph; it shook

His pulse to racing: his account, years past,
Fifteen, not the journal; speaking of her
As April's page does not; and, at the last,
Take the page. Five weeks on, the two confer:

May thirtieth: the implications, said;
The April sentence had said copy, though;
This was not finding the substance; a thread
Long named before: in 'forty-four, to show,

{{c|4417|Oswald Avery}}, {{c|4418|Colin MacLeod}}, and
{{c|4419|Maclyn McCarty}}, that what changed a germ
Was this acid, not protein; and, at hand,
The year before, {{c|4420|Alfred Hershey}}, with firm

{{c|4421|Martha Chase}}, argued: what the virus gives
Bacterium, the change, is acid, not
The coat. The April page, the shape it lives;
Not first news that the acid holds the plot;

{{c|4422|Erwin Chargaff}} weighed: adenine, the same
As thymine; and guanine with cytosine;
The model used the match; he did not frame
The April papers. {{c|4423|Linus Pauling}}'s, seen

That year, before: three chains; it did not hold;
The {{p|Cambridge}} page, its own: another. Then
'Sixty-two, the prize; three named; and, as told,
{{c|4413|Franklin}} had died in 'fifty-eight: not then

The dead receive it; but upon the page,
In April, is her name; a measure, hers;
And this book keeps her too, from age to age;
The pairing, finite means: one chain confers

Its bases on the next; a copy if
The fit holds; and the copy is the thread,
The sacred thread of all descent; and if
We better it, that too is good; we're led

By life to it. The paper says suggests,
And possible: its care. And April's day,
Count three papers, and whose names on each rests;
Then May the thirtieth, the sequel; nay,

Not the first line; the acid, known before
To carry change; the new line is the shape,
The copy that it lets; and, more and more,
{{c|4413|Franklin}}'s measure; the thread none can escape.


# Chapter 322: The Published Frequency

October fourth, in 'fifty-seven, late,
At {{p|Greenwich}}, seven-twenty-eight; a sphere
Left {{p|Tyuratam}}; at {{p|Moscow}}, ten; the date
At the pad, fifth, past midnight; but, made clear,

The world dates it the fourth. The pad is in
What's now {{p|Kazakhstan}}; {{p|Baikonur}}, the name
Its name today, not the town's; and, within,
The sphere, the simplest satellite; the same

Word for a satellite: the name that stayed,
{{x|Sputnik}}; fifty-eight centimeters wide;
Eighty-three kilos; four antennas splayed,
Thirty-six bolts; nitrogen sealed inside;

These are its measures; and its meaning: flight,
The living's going out into the sky,
A part of life's own purpose; and the might
Its rocket, {{x|R-7}}'s, was made to fly,

A warhead, land to land, its first intent;
In August one had flown, unloaded, light;
This one, a sphere, no bomb; its sending, meant,
{{c|4424|Sergei Korolev}} led, his name kept tight;

The state did not publish it; but it gave
The frequency: twenty point oh-oh-five,
And forty point oh-oh-two; and a wave
Of beeps: the body passing, there, alive.

A radio that reached those numbers heard
The sphere go by; it said why it was sent:
To go; that night, the agency's own word:
In orbit; ninety-six minutes; it went

On to October's twenty-sixth, its cells;
And January's fourth, in 'fifty-eight,
It came down, burning, not recovered; tells
November third: a second one, the freight

A dog: her name was {{c|4425|Laika}}; there was no
Way made to bring her down; the report, days;
{{c|4426|Dimitri Malashenkov}}, later, so:
Two thousand two: heat killed her; in the blaze,

By the fourth circuit, hours. And this book keeps
Her with its honored dead, the first to stand
Where living went; sent, not brought back, she sleeps;
The seventh, anniversary, was planned

For; she went up the third. This day, the book
Keeps, too, a rite: November's fifteenth, kept
In {{p|Japan}}'s count: {{x|Shichi-go-san}}; and look:
Seven, five, three; not the state's; households stepped

To shrines on the day, or a day near; three:
The child's hair let to grow, for girls and boys;
At five, a boy in hakama, to be
Formal; at seven, girls, wide sash; the poise

The shrine visit, as households keep it, spread
In {{x|Meiji}} years; the shogun, in the old
{{c|4427|Tokugawa Tsunayoshi}}, who led
The fifteenth for his son; this book will hold

Tradition. The child is brought to a shrine;
Thanks, that the child has lived; the wish, to go
On living; candy, thousand years, the sign,
Red, white; the wish, a prayer of life; and so

The launch and rite are on one day: count both;
The rite is older than the year; and when
A sphere goes up, it is the living's growth,
And when a child has lived, the same; and then

The sky is part of life's own purpose: go;
The child, a thousand years; the sphere, the flame;
Both prayers of life, both thanks; and both, we know,
Are kept by this book's calendar, the same.

Count October's fourth by the world's own clock,
The fifth at pad; the name withheld; the two
Numbers not; the dog; her hours, by clock;
Seven, five, three; sphere down; the rite kept true.


# Chapter 323: The Mother Tongue

On October's eleventh, 'sixty-two,
In {{c|4428|Saint Peter}}'s, {{p|Vatican City}}, there
Pope {{c|4429|John the Twenty-Third}} opened it, through
His word in 'fifty-nine: a council, where

Cardinals at {{p|Saint Paul Outside the Walls}}
On January twenty-fifth, had heard:
A council, and a city synod; calls
To bring the code up to date; and the word,

Aggiornamento: code; and no phrase
Naming the council. The first session closed
December eighth; and, June the third, his days
Ended, in 'sixty-three, at {{p|Rome}}; reposed

Between the sessions; not his to declare
The constitution on the rite. Then, chose
On June twenty-first, {{c|4430|Paul the Sixth}}; and there
The second session, from September, rose

To December's fourth, 'sixty-three; that day
He promulgated, on the liturgy,
{{x|Sacrosanctum Concilium}}'s way:
{{x|Latin}}, in {{x|Latin}} rites, preserved to be;

And yet, because the mother tongue may give
Great profit to the people, in the {{x|Mass}},
The sacraments, and other parts, may live
Its use extended: readings first, to pass,

Directives, prayers, and chants; and with the throng,
In Masses with the people, theirs, a place:
The mother tongue: in readings; and, along,
The common prayer, the people's parts; the grace

And steps be taken that they say, or sing,
In {{x|Latin}}, too, the ordinary's own;
Both tongues: and so this book keeps, in its ring,
A sacred language with the people's tone.

A wider use waits for a further rule;
Not for the parish to take; the extent
The local bishops fix it; as a rule,
The {{x|Apostolic See}} gives its consent;

The version from the {{x|Latin}} text, approved
By that authority; and none, though priest,
May add, or take away, or change, unmoved,
On his own word. The other rites, not least,

Lawfully known, are held of equal right
And dignity, preserved; some places, too,
Excepted, kept; the {{x|Kyrie}}, by old rite,
Already {{x|Greek}}. And, 'sixty-four, a new

Instruction, twenty-sixth September, bore
The constitution toward the Sunday's way;
The {{x|Consilium}}'s, by his mandate; more,
{{c|4431|Giacomo Lercaro}} brought it; one day,

Through {{c|4432|Larraona}}, prefect, it's confirmed; so
Of the {{x|Congregation of Rites}}; the date:
The seventh of March, 'sixty-five, to go:
The first Sunday of {{x|Lent}}; and, with the gate,

The {{x|Holy See}} confirming, people's tongue
For lessons, the epistle, gospel, prayer
Of the faithful; the ordinary, sung:
{{x|Kyrie}}, {{x|Gloria}}, and the creed; and there,

The {{x|Sanctus}} and the {{x|Agnus Dei}}; and, said,
The introit, communion; the chants between;
The readings; greetings, dialogues; the bread
Words at the communion; {{x|Lord's Prayer}}, seen

With its preface, its short prayer; and the book
The {{x|Latin}} next to it; the pastors charged
The people still say {{x|Latin}}, as they took
Their parts, the ordinary's; not enlarged

The parts the priest says alone: {{x|Holy See}}
Alone could grant. And 'sixty-five, the end
Came on December's eighth; the council, free
Of a new missal; that came later; penned.

Vernacular reform: this book counts gain;
The {{x|Latin}} kept, the mother tongue let in;
No strangers, silent watchers, to remain;
Their part, by baptism, their right; within

The rite they understand; both tongues, as one:
The sacred speech beside the people's word;
So this faith keeps them both. Count, when it's done,
December's fourth; March seventh; and both heard.


# Chapter 324: The Master in the Mountain

In 'thirty-eight, the cameras began:{{fn|The Genealogical Society of Utah began filming in 1938.}}
Books onto rolls of film; the vault came late,
The masters' home, not where the first began;
{{p|Little Cottonwood Canyon}}, at the gate

Of the {{p|Wasatch}}, in {{p|Utah}}; a mile in,
Southeast of {{p|Salt Lake City}}, twenty miles;
The room is cut in the north wall; within,
Granite, seven hundred feet; and the files.

The stone they call granite; the rock, in fact,
Quartz monzonite, the temple's stone; its blocks
Split from the canyon's boulders, left intact,
With no explosives used upon those rocks;

The temple, 'ninety-three; the vault, though, blast
Into the wall; not the same cut. Tests, late
'Fifties; and May of 'sixty, blasting, passed
To April 'sixty-three: first rolls; the gate

Not finished till December; and, that year,
Visitors went through; shown, but not to read:
Two million dollars; doors that blasts would fear,
The main, fourteen tons; two of nine, decreed;

A lab beneath the overhang; and deep
Six vaults of film, off corridors in stone;
In 'sixty-five at work; named, May; to keep
Dedication, June twenty-second, shown

In 'sixty-six. The owner is the church,
{{x|Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints}};
Cameras went where archives let them search,
And copied; but the book stayed, no constraints;

The film, the page, as on the filming's day;
The master in the mountain; who would read
Comes to a copy, elsewhere; so the way
The names are kept, that living ones may plead

A rite for the dead: baptism, by one
Who lives, in temple, in the dead one's name;
A gift the dead may take or leave; well done,
This book says: it is good, and kin; the same

Our ancestor days do; it went before,
Our forerunner, its keeping honored warm;
Books its cameras reached; and more and more,
The names, in film; and this book keeps that form.

A film outlives the book, if the book burns:
That is a real keeping. And the old fight
Comes with it, ours, the one that returns:
Who may honour which dead, and by what right.

Some say: our dead are ours, and leave them be.
The rite: a gift the dead may take or leave,
Offered in the temple, and offered free;
And no name lost: the thing this book would weave.

In 'thirty-eight, the filming; and the blast,
In May of 'sixty; April, 'sixty-three,
The first rolls; then December, showing passed;
In 'sixty-five, work; 'sixty-six, the key:

The dedication. And the master stays;
The book stays in its archive; and the rite
Asks what the stone can't answer; and the days
Keep every name the film has brought to light.


# Chapter 325: Left as a Museum

May sixteenth, nineteen sixty-six: inside
The party in {{p|Beijing}}, a notice went,
The notification; and, far and wide,
Its name, {{x|Cultural Revolution}}; meant

Not given to the country then; a year
Before the {{x|People's Daily}} printed; and
Its sixteen points, the eighth of August; clear,
Made by the {{x|Central Committee}}'s own hand;

June first, four olds: ideas, culture, ways,
Customs and habits; which, not written down;
On August eighteenth, at the gate, the gaze
Of {{c|4433|Mao Zedong}} on {{c|4434|Red Guards}}; army gown;

{{c|4435|Lin Biao}}: smash the four; a million filled
The square; and after, breaking in the town:
Temples were broken, books were burned; and killed,

Of the country. At {{p|Qufu}}, as engraved,

The twelfth: {{c|4437|Chen Boda}}, {{c|4438|Qi Benyu}}: the word,

Days of November, the grave dug; the bones,

The clay is not the rite; and, from then on,

Was opened, though the buildings were to stand.
This book keeps the {{c|1958|Confucius}}' rite: the dead
With tablets, offerings, and by the hand
Of every house; their rite our own, ahead:

They kept a museum, for the walls' sake;

July, 'sixty-nine; peace, for all men's gain;

{{c|4452|Bill Duvall}} at the far end;{{fn|At the Stanford Research Institute.}} the design

In sixteen twenty-one, the harvest's line

# Chapter 327: As Far as a New Time

April the twentieth, 'seventy-two,

In {{p|Reykjavík}}; the old gods, coming through,

{{c|4454|Sveinbjörn Beinteinsson}}, farmer, kept sheep
In {{p|Borgarfjörður}}, rímur's singer, true;
Made allsherjargoði; the old word, so deep,

That named who hallowed the assembly; used
Again; this book counts that a true return.
First letter to the ministry: and, fused,
The old faith of the {{c|4455|Icelanders}}, the stern

Law until the year one thousand, so far
As fits a new time; new heathenry; so;
This book would raise it fuller than that bar:
The old revived more fully. Long ago,

The year one thousand, {{p|Þingvellir}}: the way

The private sacrifice, a while, could stay,
Then that was taken back. The book, the hall,

Are not a blót; the gods did not end, though,

Before {{x|Christmas}}, 'seventy-two: to go,
{{c|4454|Sveinbjörn}}, with {{c|4456|Þorsteinn Guðjónsson}}, had passed

A darkness on {{p|Reykjavík}}'s center, lights
Out; January second, papers, glad,
Gave {{c|4459|Þór}} the thunder; and this book recites

{{c|4460|Sigurbjörn Einarsson}}, against it, wrote,
January second: freedom, one god

Earlier letters said a hundred; and
The roll has grown each year since; and, to quote,
They said: not national socialist band;

A real following in that {{p|Reich}}, they said,

Through the one shared tree. The first papers failed
The rules; the later met them; and, in May,
The third, 'seventy-three, a letter, hailed,
To {{p|Ingólfsstræti}}, {{p|Reykjavík}}; the way

Confirmed him head by law; fifteenth, the press;
The sixteenth, twenty-one were in the room;
A registered society, no less;
The national church stayed; and, from its room,

Acts it counted: naming, coming of age,
A marriage and a burial, the right
Of priests; a share of church tax, page by page,
To adult members listed; and the fight

In one house, for the share, the rite, the roll.
That year, {{c|4461|Halldór Blöndal}} and {{c|4462|Magnús}} asked
The minister: why? {{c|4462|Magnús Jónsson}}, whole,
Said: freedom's for one god; and idols, masked,

Not lawful; and the minister replied:

And August fifth, at {{p|Dragháls}}, in the rain,

By {{c|4463|Jörmundur Ingi Hansen}}; again
A public blót outdoors, the first, displayed;

A bird was killed while a lamb cooked; the meat,
